title: Counting on Dummies: Privacy Amplification with Observable Counts and Truncated Batches
abstract: In many practical deployments of Differentially Private Stochastic Gradient Descent (DP-SGD), the server processes data in batches. Randomly sampling these batches allows for better privacy bounds via privacy amplification results. Most sampling schemes with provable privacy amplification, including Poisson sampling and random allocation, result in variable batch sizes. The privacy guarantee of these schemes requires that the batch sizes are not revealed. In distributed settings, the server performing the aggregation or any party observing the communication traffic may learn these batch sizes. Furthermore, in both centralized and distributed settings, memory and computation constraints may require each batch to be of some maximum size $s$, necessitating truncation of the batch when it exceeds this limit. It is known that this truncation can result in a significant increase in privacy loss. In this work, we address both of these challenges via a simple mechanism that uses a random number of \emph{dummy points} to privatize the batch size and maintain the privacy guarantee even under truncation. We demonstrate that our mechanism is easy to implement in a distributed setting, and provide a general analysis of this mechanism for both Poisson sampling and random allocation. Our analysis is designed to support efficient and relatively tight privacy accounting. It also effectively amplifies the privacy of the count releases by subsampling, making the expected number of dummy points asymptotically smaller than what is needed to directly privatize the (sensitivity-one) batch sizes with non-negative noise. For Poisson sampling with truncated batches, we demonstrate empirically that our mechanism achieves better privacy--efficiency tradeoffs than the direct accounting for truncation recently given by (Ganesh, 2025).
title_cn: 靠哑元计数：可观测计数与截断批次下的隐私放大
abstract_cn: 在差分隐私随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）的许多实际部署中，服务器按批次处理数据。随机采样批次可借助隐私放大结果获得更好的隐私界。多数带可证隐私放大的采样方案（包括泊松采样与随机分配）导致批次大小可变，而这些方案的隐私保证要求批次大小不被公开。在分布式设置中，执行聚合的服务器或任何观察通信流量的参与方都可能得知批次大小。此外，无论集中式还是分布式，内存与计算约束可能要求每批次不超过最大规模 s，超过即需截断——已知截断会显著加剧隐私损失。本工作用一个简单机制同时应对这两个挑战：用随机数量的哑元（dummy）点私有化批次大小，使隐私保证在截断下依然成立。我们证明该机制在分布式设置中易于实现，并对泊松采样与随机分配给出一般分析。分析设计为支持高效且相对紧凑的隐私核算，还通过子采样有效放大数据计数发布的隐私，使哑元点期望数量渐近小于直接以非负噪声私有化（敏感度为 1 的）批次大小所需。对带截断批次的泊松采样，我们以实验证明该机制取得比 Ganesh（2025）近期给出的直接截断核算更好的隐私—效率权衡。
summary_cn: 用随机哑元点私有化 DP-SGD 批次大小，使泊松采样/随机分配的隐私放大在批次大小可观测与截断下依然成立，核算更紧凑，隐私—效率权衡优于 Ganesh 2025 的直接截断核算。
objective_summary: 提出以随机哑元点私有化批次大小的机制，覆盖批次大小可观测与截断两类部署现实，并对泊松采样与随机分配给出一般化隐私核算与实验对比。
evidence_note: 一般化理论分析（覆盖两种采样方案）+ 与近期工作（Ganesh 2025）的实验权衡对比；证明完整性良好但非紧界突破，无会议信息。
novelty_note: 首次把「批次大小可观测」与「截断」两个部署现实纳入统一隐私放大处理，哑元机制简单有效；问题设定新、方法朴素直接。
scope: 结论适用于 DP-SGD 类以随机批次训练的集中/分布式部署；隐私定义为 DP，不含更大威胁模型。
limitations: 哑元点引入额外计算与通信开销；分析针对泊松采样与随机分配，其他采样方案未覆盖；紧凑性为「相对」而非最优。

title: Beyond Smart Homes: Characterizing IoT Vulnerabilities Across Sectors, Vendors, and Products
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has expanded beyond consumer smart homes to sectors, such as industrial systems, healthcare, and smart cities, broadening the IoT attack surface. Prior empirical work has focused on studying aggregate IoT vulnerability characteristics or specific protocols, so patching is directed by aggregate security guidance. However, if dominant weaknesses differ substantially across sectors or products, such uniform guidance misdirects the remediation effort. To address this gap, we present a fine-grained, data-driven analysis of IoT vulnerabilities using a dataset of more than 15,000 IoT specific CVEs. We design a pipeline to enrich noisy CPE (Common Platform Enumeration) metadata, normalizing vendors and products, then assigning product type and sector labels using lexical matching, fuzzy clustering, and LLM-assisted classification. We find meaningful differences in the weakness profile of IoT sectors. For example, healthcare is dominated by authentication and credential weaknesses, while automotive faces memory issues. More importantly, we find that weakness profiles are more similar across different product types from the same vendor than across the same product type built by different vendors. This suggests vendor-level factors such as shared code and development practices dominate weakness inheritance, making a vendor's disclosure history informative about its other products. Our findings suggest weakness classes should be used to prioritize remediation efforts.
title_cn: 超越智能家居：跨行业、厂商与产品刻画 IoT 漏洞
abstract_cn: 物联网（IoT）已扩展到工业系统、医疗与智慧城市等行业，攻击面随之扩大。既有实证工作多研究 IoT 漏洞的总体特征或特定协议，修补工作因此由总体性安全指南引导。但如果主导弱点在行业或产品间差异显著，这种统一指南会误导修补投入。为填补缺口，我们基于超过 15,000 条 IoT 特定 CVE 进行细粒度、数据驱动的漏洞分析。我们设计管线富化含噪的 CPE 元数据，规范化厂商与产品，再以词法匹配、模糊聚类与 LLM 辅助分类赋予产品类型与行业标签。我们发现各行业 IoT 弱点画像存在实质差异：例如医疗行业以认证与凭据弱点为主，汽车行业则以内存问题为主。更重要的是，同一厂商不同产品类型的弱点画像比不同厂商同一产品类型更相似——表明共享代码与开发实践等厂商级因素主导弱点继承，使厂商的披露历史对其其他产品具有信息量。研究结论支持以弱点类别引导修补投入的优先级。
summary_cn: 基于 15,000+ IoT CVE 的细粒度分析：医疗以认证/凭据弱点为主、汽车以内存问题为主；同厂商不同产品类型的弱点画像比同类型不同厂商更相似，厂商级因素主导弱点继承。
objective_summary: 以 CPE 富化与多级标注管线对 15,000 余条 IoT CVE 做行业/厂商/产品维度的细粒度画像，量化弱点分布差异与厂商级弱点继承效应。
evidence_note: 15,000+ CVE 的规模化分析，管线含词法匹配、模糊聚类与 LLM 辅助分类，结论量化到行业对比；标注质量依赖自动管线、无统计检验与会议信息。
novelty_note: 把 IoT 漏洞测量从总体统计推进到行业/厂商/产品三维画像并给出「厂商 > 产品类型」的弱点继承结论，对修补策略有直接诊断价值。
scope: 结论适用于公开 CVE 记录可见的 IoT 漏洞生态；未披露漏洞与内部缺陷不在测量范围内。
limitations: CVE 与 CPE 数据本身有偏（知名厂商披露更多）；LLM 辅助标注存在误差；未验证厂商继承效应的因果机制。

title: SecPO: Principled Adversarial Training for Prompt Injection Security
abstract: Recognized as a top threat to AI agents, prompt injection allows instructions from untrusted data (email, documents, websites) to manipulate the agent's operation. The existing best-defended LLM, Meta-SecAlign, is trained with the DPO loss but still suffers from attack success rates (ASRs) approaching 100% under adaptive prompt injections. One reason is that DPO anchors the model around the undefended reference model, which is insecure. We show an idealized reference model---an injection-invariant, utility-preserving oracle---can nevertheless be approximated, as its output distribution in training is interestingly accessible. This new observation motivates a theoretically principled SecPO loss. Another Meta-SecAlign shortcoming is that it trains on weak simulated attacks. We implement an efficient adversarial training (AT) pipeline that synthesizes strong injected inputs (best@240), and train the model on them. Our AT reduces ASRs by 1.5-14.5$\times$ across three SoTA adaptive attacks, compared with Meta-SecAlign; the SecPO loss reduces them by a further 2.4-4.6$\times$ compared with using DPO loss. In agentic workflows, our SecPO + AT Qwen3.6-27B is much more secure than Meta-SecAlign: 8.8% vs. 78.8% AgentDojo ASR@800 under the AttackerMovesSecond attack. Moreover, our defended model shows no noticeable reduction in benign utility in nine benchmarks covering agentic tool calling, instruction following, science, and math. We release our $\href{//github.com/Sizhe-Chen/SecPO}{\text{code}}$, $\href{//huggingface.co/datasets/Sizhe-Chen/Qwen3.6-27B-Instruct-SecPO-trainset}{\text{training data}}$ (with optimized injections from AT), and $\href{//huggingface.co/Sizhe-Chen/Qwen3.6-27B-Instruct-SecPO}{\text{model}}$.
title_cn: SecPO：面向提示注入安全的原则性对抗训练
abstract_cn: 提示注入被公认为 AI 智能体的头号威胁：来自不可信数据（邮件、文档、网站）的指令可以操纵智能体行为。现有防御最强的 LLM Meta-SecAlign 以 DPO 损失训练，但在自适应提示注入下攻击成功率（ASR）仍接近 100%。一个原因是 DPO 把模型锚定在未设防的参考模型上。我们证明一个理想化的参考模型——注入不变、保持效用的 oracle——依然可以被逼近，因为其训练输出分布有趣地可得。这一新观察催生了有理论原则的 SecPO 损失。Meta-SecAlign 的另一短板是用弱模拟攻击训练。我们实现一条高效的对抗训练（AT）流水线合成强注入输入（best@240）并以其训练模型。与 Meta-SecAlign 相比，我们的 AT 在三个 SoTA 自适应攻击下把 ASR 降低 1.5–14.5 倍；SecPO 损失相对 DPO 损失再降 2.4–4.6 倍。在智能体工作流中，我们的 SecPO + AT Qwen3.6-27B 远比 Meta-SecAlign 安全：AttackerMovesSecond 攻击下 AgentDojo ASR@800 为 8.8% 对 78.8%。同时，我们的防御模型在覆盖智能体工具调用、指令遵循、科学与数学的九个基准上未见明显的良性效用损失。代码、训练数据（含 AT 优化的注入）与模型均已发布。
summary_cn: 指出 DPO 防御锚定在不安全参考模型上，提出 SecPO 损失 + 强对抗训练：三个自适应攻击下 ASR 比 Meta-SecAlign 低 1.5–14.5 倍（再乘 2.4–4.6 倍），AgentDojo ASR@800 8.8% 对 78.8%，九个良性基准无效用损失。
objective_summary: 分析 DPO 式防御的不安全锚定问题，提出以可逼近的注入不变 oracle 为参考的 SecPO 损失并配套强对抗训练流水线，在自适应攻击与良性基准上量化安全—效用权衡。
evidence_note: 三个 SoTA 自适应攻击 + AgentDojo 智能体工作流 + 九个良性效用基准的系统对照，代码/数据/模型全公开；理论部分为 oracle 可逼近性论证；无会议信息。
novelty_note: 识别并修复 DPO 锚定不安全参考这一结构性缺陷，SecPO 损失有理论动机、对抗训练流水线直达自适应强攻击，是对注入防御训练范式的实质推进。
scope: 结论适用于注入不变性可被训练逼近的 LLM 与智能体工作流场景；对与外部状态耦合的新型注入向量未完全覆盖。
limitations: 安全增益以已知自适应攻击族衡量；SecPO 的 oracle 逼近依赖训练分布假设；27B 单一模型规模，更大/更小规模未报告。

title: On-Chain Behavioral Signatures for Classifying Centralized Exchange Addresses on Ethereum Using Proof-of-Reserves
abstract: Centralized exchanges (CEXs) are key gateways between traditional finance and digital asset markets, yet identifying their blockchain addresses remains challenging. Existing approaches often rely on opaque attribution labels or treat exchanges as secondary classification targets, leaving generalization to unseen exchanges insufficiently examined. This study develops a classification framework using Proof-of-Reserves (PoR) disclosures, with 3,033,857 Ethereum addresses from 15 CEXs and five Non-CEX categories. We derive 58 on-chain behavioral features and evaluate LightGBM against logistic regression (LR) under a leave-one-exchange-out protocol. Across five lookback windows (30-730 days), LightGBM consistently outperformed LR, with macro PR-AUC increasing from 0.6611 to 0.9594 using the selected 17 features, compared with 0.7697 for LR at 730 days. Robustness checks showed comparable performance when feature selection and hyperparameter optimization were repeated across splits and held-out exchanges, while exchange-balanced reweighting improved macro PR-AUC. SHAP analysis and feature-group ablation identified gas behavior, ERC-20 token activity, and internal transactions as key predictive signals in the constructed dataset. These findings support interpretable CEX address screening for blockchain monitoring, while the released feature dataset enables reproducible follow-up research.
comment: Accepted at the 7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance (ICAIF '26)
title_cn: 基于储备证明的链上行为签名：以太坊中心化交易所地址分类
abstract_cn: 中心化交易所（CEX）是传统金融与数字资产市场之间的关键门户，但识别其区块链地址仍有难度。现有方法常依赖不透明的归属标签，或把交易所作为次要分类目标，对未见交易所的泛化检验不足。本研究构建一个使用储备证明（PoR）披露的分类框架，覆盖来自 15 家 CEX 与五个非 CEX 类别的 3,033,857 个以太坊地址。我们提取 58 个链上行为特征，在留一交易所协议下对比 LightGBM 与逻辑回归（LR）。在五个回看窗口（30–730 天）上，LightGBM 一致优于 LR：使用筛选出的 17 个特征，宏 PR-AUC 从 0.6611 提升到 0.9594，LR 在 730 天为 0.7697。鲁棒性检查显示跨划分与留出交易所重复特征筛选与超参优化时性能相当，交易所均衡重加权进一步改善宏 PR-AUC。SHAP 分析与特征组消融识别出 gas 行为、ERC-20 代币活动与内部交易为关键预测信号。这些发现支持可解释的 CEX 地址筛查用于区块链监控，所发布特征数据集支持可复现的后续研究（ICAIF '26 录用）。
summary_cn: 以储备证明披露构建 15 家 CEX 共 303 万以太坊地址的分类框架：留一交易所下 LightGBM 宏 PR-AUC 0.6611→0.9594（17 特征），SHAP 指向 gas 行为、ERC-20 活动与内部交易（ICAIF '26）。
objective_summary: 基于储备证明披露构建 CEX 地址链上行为特征集与 LightGBM 分类框架，在留一交易所协议下量化性能、鲁棒性与关键特征。
evidence_note: ICAIF '26 录用；303 万地址、留一交易所泛化协议、跨划分鲁棒性检查、SHAP 与特征组消融，特征数据集发布。
novelty_note: 以 PoR 披露为锚定构建 CEX 地址集是新的数据角度，泛化协议严格；分类管线（LightGBM + SHAP）为标准技术。
scope: 结论适用于以太坊上 PoR 披露可得的 CEX 地址识别；对不发布 PoR 的交易所以及其他链未覆盖。
limitations: PoR 披露本身可能不完整或不可核验；标签来自交易所自报地址集；特征可随交易所行为演变漂移。

title: How Much Can Tool Calls Reveal About You? Privacy Leakage from Tool-Call Traces
abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents interact with external tools through protocols such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP), producing tool-call traces that may expose behavioral signals about users. In this work, we systematically study the risk of user-profile inference from MCP tool-call traces, where observers infer user attributes from protocol-valid tool interactions without access to user conversations. We introduce PrivacyTrace, a benchmark containing 1,000 synthetic user profiles and 4,000 agent trajectories across four domains, generated with real MCP tools from 25 servers. Experiments with four mainstream LLM attackers show that tool-call traces enable a 26.25% attack success rate for profile inference, compared with 17.97% from prior-based guessing. Further analysis reveals that tool arguments and returned results provide the main trace-grounded evidence, while linking traces across sessions further amplifies profiling risk. These findings demonstrate that MCP tool-call traces can act as effective behavioral side channels for user profiling, motivating the development of privacy-aware mechanisms for agent-tool interactions. Code and data are available at https://github.com/AI45Lab/PrivacyTrace.

title_cn: 工具调用能泄露多少你的信息？来自工具调用轨迹的隐私泄露
abstract_cn: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体通过模型上下文协议（MCP）等协议与外部工具交互，产生的工具调用轨迹可能暴露用户的行为信号。我们系统研究从 MCP 工具调用轨迹推断用户画像的风险：观察者在无法访问用户对话的情况下，从协议合法的工具交互推断用户属性。我们提出 PrivacyTrace 基准，包含 1,000 个合成用户画像与四个领域 4,000 条智能体轨迹，均以 25 个服务器的真实 MCP 工具生成。四个主流 LLM 攻击者的实验表明：工具调用轨迹使画像推断攻击成功率达 26.25%，而基于先验的猜测为 17.97%。进一步分析显示工具参数与返回结果提供主要的轨迹内证据，而跨会话链接轨迹进一步放大画像风险。这些发现证明 MCP 工具调用轨迹可作为用户画像的有效行为侧信道，提示需要为智能体—工具交互开发隐私感知机制。代码与数据见 https://github.com/AI45Lab/PrivacyTrace。
summary_cn: MCP 工具调用轨迹可作行为侧信道：PrivacyTrace 基准（1,000 画像 × 4,000 轨迹）上四个 LLM 攻击者的画像推断成功率 26.25% 对先验猜测 17.97%，跨会话链接进一步放大风险。
objective_summary: 构建基于真实 MCP 工具的 PrivacyTrace 基准，系统量化无对话访问的观察者从工具调用轨迹推断用户属性的能力及其放大因素。
evidence_note: 1,000 画像 × 4,000 轨迹、25 个真实 MCP 服务器生成、四个攻击 LLM 对照先验基线，代码数据公开；画像与轨迹为合成、无统计检验与会议信息。
novelty_note: 首次系统量化 MCP 工具调用轨迹这一新兴交互面的画像隐私风险，并把跨会话链接识别为放大因子，开辟智能体隐私的新侧信道方向。
scope: 结论适用于 MCP 类协议的工具调用轨迹；合成画像与轨迹与真实用户分布的差异未标定。
limitations: 画像与轨迹为合成生成，真实分布外推存疑；攻击者已知画像候选集的设定偏强；仅四域四攻击模型。

title: Exploring Bad Minima in Transfer Learning
abstract: Transfer learning is a highly successful learning paradigm in deep learning which leverages knowledge from one task and applies it to another. Despite its success, the necessary conditions for knowledge transfer are unclear and require further research. In this dissertation, our aim is to understand transferability a little better by answering the following question: Does good generalization on a source task necessarily imply transferability to a related target task? We hypothesize the answer is negative, and attempt to find counterexamples via adversarial attacks on the transfer learning procedure. Over three types of adversarial attacks, our empirical results show a strong relationship between generalization on the source task and transferability. These results do not rule out generalization on the source task as a sufficient condition for successful transfer.

title_cn: 探索迁移学习中的坏极小值
abstract_cn: 迁移学习是深度学习中非常成功的学习范式，它把从一个任务学到的知识应用于另一个任务。尽管成效显著，知识迁移的必要条件仍不清楚、需要进一步研究。本论文（剑桥大学 MPhil 学位论文，2022）旨在通过回答以下问题更好地理解可迁移性：源任务上的良好泛化是否必然意味着向相关目标任务的可迁移性？我们假设答案是否定的，并尝试通过对迁移学习过程实施对抗攻击来寻找反例。在三类对抗攻击上，我们的实证结果显示源任务泛化与可迁移性之间存在强关系。这些结果不能排除源任务泛化作为成功迁移的充分条件。
summary_cn: 剑桥 MPhil 论文（2022）：以三类对抗攻击寻找「源任务泛化但不可迁移」的反例，实证却显示源任务泛化与可迁移性强相关，未能证伪充分性。
objective_summary: 以三类对抗攻击探究源任务良好泛化是否蕴含向目标任务的可迁移性，报告未找到反例、两者呈强关系的实证结论。
evidence_note: 2022 年 MPhil 学位论文，三类攻击的实证探索，未经同行评审发表；未报告统计检验，实验规模有限（57 页但摘要信息少）。
novelty_note: 对老问题（泛化与可迁移性的关系）给出未证伪的探索性结论，无新方法或新发现；对抗攻击仅作研究手段而非安全贡献。
scope: 结论限于论文所测的三类攻击与任务对；不构成对可迁移性一般理论的判断。

title: What Standard Evaluations Hide About Detectors of Hijacked LLM Agents: Rare Attacks, Unseen Tools and Benchmark Transfer
abstract: Detectors can flag hijacked large language model (LLM) agents from the traces of the tools they call. In the eleven evaluations we audited, attacks or anomalies make up 16% to 86% of the test samples, no evaluation varies that share, and six report no test on data from a second benchmark or source. We ask what such evaluations hide. On the AgentDrift and AgentDojo benchmarks we test trained detectors that read tool identities, behavior, call sequences, step embeddings or text, and a released LLM action monitor, AlignmentCheck, with thresholds fixed on training data or set by the monitor's released decision rule. First, at a 2% attack rate a detector with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.879 reaches a precision of 0.076, and the mix of negatives alone moves that precision between 0.039 and 0.117. Second, as tool coverage, the share of test tool calls whose tool was seen in training, falls, detector rankings cross near 50% coverage and reverse below it, because unseen tools map to inputs that training never reached. Dropout on tool inputs largely removes the reversal. Third, no detector trained on AgentDrift ranks AgentDojo traces better than chance (AUROC 0.47 to 0.52), including one that reaches 0.996 within AgentDojo. The monitor, trained on neither, reaches 0.930, but with its open backbone its released decision rule would still mostly raise false alerts at a 2% attack rate (precision 0.096). We turn these findings into a checklist for evaluating trace detectors.

title_cn: 标准评估掩盖了被劫持 LLM 智能体检测器的什么：罕见攻击、未见工具与基准迁移
abstract_cn: 检测器可以从 LLM 智能体调用工具的轨迹中标记被劫持的智能体。在我们审计的 11 项评估中，攻击或异常占测试样本的 16% 到 86%，没有一项改变该占比，六项未做任何第二基准或数据源的测试。我们追问这样的评估掩盖了什么。在 AgentDrift 与 AgentDojo 基准上，我们测试读取工具身份、行为、调用序列、步嵌入或文本的训练式检测器，以及一个已发布的 LLM 动作监视器 AlignmentCheck，阈值固定于训练数据或按其发布的决策规则设定。首先，在 2% 攻击率下，AUROC 0.879 的检测器精确率仅 0.076，而负样本构成的变化即让精确率在 0.039 与 0.117 间移动。其次，随工具覆盖率（测试工具调用中训练时见过的比例）下降，检测器排名在约 50% 覆盖率附近交叉并在其下反转，因为未见工具映射到训练从未到达的输入；对工具输入做 dropout 基本消除该反转。第三，在 AgentDrift 上训练的检测器对 AgentDojo 轨迹的排序都不优于随机（AUROC 0.47–0.52），包括一个在 AgentDojo 内达 0.996 的检测器；未在两者上训练的监视器达 0.930，但其公开骨干搭配其发布决策规则在 2% 攻击率下仍基本产生误报（精确率 0.096）。我们将这些发现转化为轨迹检测器评估清单。代码、数据与每次监视器调用均已公开。
summary_cn: 审计 11 项被劫持智能体检测器评估：2% 攻击率下 AUROC 0.879 的精确率仅 0.076，工具覆盖率低于 50% 时排名反转，跨基准 AUROC 跌至 0.47–0.52，并给出评估清单（代码与全部监视器调用公开）。
objective_summary: 系统审计被劫持 LLM 智能体检测器的评估实践，量化攻击基率、工具覆盖率与跨基准迁移对检测器排序和精确率的影响，并产出评估清单。
evidence_note: 11 项评估审计 + 两基准多类检测器受控实验 + 已发布监视器复测，量化基率、覆盖率与迁移三重效应；代码数据与监视器调用全公开；无会议信息。
novelty_note: 对该方向评估方法的首个系统化审计：给出排名交叉与反转的机制解释（未见工具映射）与清单化修正，直接改变轨迹检测器的评估与部署解读。
scope: 结论适用于工具调用轨迹上的被劫持检测器及其评估；结论强度限于所测两基准与检测器集合。
limitations: 两基准之外的真实生产轨迹未覆盖；修复建议（dropout、清单）为经验性；对训练侧改进未提出方案。

title: Reparo: Synthesizing and Validating Access Control Policies
abstract: Writing correct access control policies for software applications is difficult because it requires expertise in the authorization language and a thorough understanding of the application's authorization requirements. Existing synthesis and mining approaches assume explicit authorization inputs and a trusted reference policy. However, authorization logic is often distributed across code, comments, and documentation rather than captured in a single artifact, and developer-defined policies in real-world application repositories are often incomplete, outdated, or incorrect. We present Reparo, an LLM-aided pipeline for access control policy synthesis, repair, and validation. Reparo collects repository evidence for authorization intent and uses it to guide an LLM in generating an initial policy. It then uses official policy-language validation tools to identify and automatically repair errors. For semantic validation, a different LLM derives a behavioral oracle from the same repository evidence, consisting of concrete authorization requests with expected allow or deny decisions, which Reparo executes against the generated policy. We manually assess the oracle on a statistically sized sample of 390 test cases. We evaluate Reparo on 228 real-world GitHub repositories that use Cedar, OpenFGA, or Rego. In these repositories, 40.6-55.7% of the repository policies fail their language's validation tool, whereas Reparo produces 99.0-100% valid policies after repair. Agreement with the oracle is 98.2-99.6% for OpenFGA, 82.0-86.5% for Cedar, and 76.3-80.2% for Rego. Manual review confirms 91.5-96.9% of the sampled test cases as correct. Synthesizing and validating the policy for one repository takes about five minutes and costs $0.55-$1.57. These results show that repository evidence can support both access policy synthesis and independent validation, even when no reliable reference policy exists.
title_cn: Reparo：访问控制策略的合成与验证
abstract_cn: 为软件应用编写正确的访问控制策略很难：它既要求对授权语言的专长，也要求透彻理解应用的授权需求。现有合成与挖掘方法假定存在显式的授权输入与可信参照策略。然而授权逻辑常分散在代码、注释与文档中而非集中于单一工件，且真实应用仓库中开发者定义的策略往往不完整、过时或错误。我们提出 Reparo，一个 LLM 辅助的访问控制策略合成、修复与验证流水线。Reparo 从仓库收集授权意图证据并以此引导 LLM 生成初始策略，再用官方策略语言验证工具识别并自动修复错误。在语义验证上，另一个 LLM 从同一仓库证据推导行为预言机——带预期允许/拒绝决策的具体授权请求——Reparo 对生成策略执行之。我们在统计规模 390 例的样本上人工评估预言机。在 228 个使用 Cedar、OpenFGA 或 Rego 的真实 GitHub 仓库上评估 Reparo：40.6–55.7% 的仓库策略无法通过其语言的验证工具，而 Reparo 修复后产出 99.0–100% 的有效策略；与预言机的一致率为 OpenFGA 98.2–99.6%、Cedar 82.0–86.5%、Rego 76.3–80.2%；人工评审确认抽样用例中 91.5–96.9% 正确。单仓库的合成与验证约需五分钟、成本 0.55–1.57 美元。结果表明即便不存在可靠参照策略，仓库证据也能同时支持访问策略合成与独立验证。
summary_cn: LLM 流水线 Reparo 从仓库证据合成并修复访问控制策略：228 个真实仓库中 40.6–55.7% 现有策略过不了官方校验，Reparo 达 99–100% 有效，单仓库约 5 分钟、成本 0.55–1.57 美元。
objective_summary: 构建从仓库证据合成访问策略、以官方工具修复并以独立行为预言机验证的 LLM 流水线 Reparo，在 228 个真实仓库上量化有效率、预言机一致率与人工正确率。
evidence_note: 228 个真实 GitHub 仓库 + 390 例统计规模人工标注的行为预言机 + 三语言对照 + 成本时延量化；无统计检验但人工评估有样本量设计。
novelty_note: 以仓库证据取代「可信参照策略」假设并配套独立行为预言机验证，是 LLM 策略合成的扎实新组合；单点技术（LLM 生成、官方校验器）已有。
scope: 结论适用于 Cedar、OpenFGA、Rego 三种策略语言的仓库级合成与修复；预言机质量受仓库文档与注释完备度约束。
limitations: 行为预言机由 LLM 推导，语义错误的策略可能一致率虚高；Rego 一致率明显偏低；未评估运行时授权行为的端到端正确性。

title: From Training Exposure to Membership Evidence: A Controlled Study of OLMo 2
abstract: Whether a language model was trained on a document matters for copyright, privacy, and benchmark contamination. Yet most membership-inference (MI) evaluations on language models collect members and non-members after the fact, so success may reflect distribution shift and failure is inconclusive. We re-ran OLMo 2 1B's official 50-billion-token mid-training stage, replacing selected training chunks with documents from 7,814 pairs matched on domain and difficulty. For each pair, a coin flip determined which document was inserted and which was held out. The run released by the Allen Institute for AI (AI2) from the same seed saw identical data everywhere else and serves as the counterfactual. One exposure raises a previously unseen document's likelihood on average but rarely identifies it. Using the counterfactual as reference, the reference ratio has an area under the ROC curve (AUC) of 0.767 but, with one threshold across domains, catches 3.8% of members at a 1% false-positive rate (FPR). In contrast, 13 matched pairs give a paired test 80% power at the 5% level to detect training on a collection, given same-domain non-members and a close reference. A reference trained with another seed recovers 92% of the counterfactual's AUC advantage over chance, whereas reference-free attacks stay within 0.07 of chance when pooled over domains. The full official post-training recipe, re-run on both models, leaves 89% of the average effect. Even with a closely matched reference, substantial document-level variability limits individual membership inference. We will release the checkpoints, per-token log-probabilities, and the evaluation documents; the code is available at https://github.com/ali-bana/OLMo-Twin.

title_cn: 从训练暴露到成员证据：OLMo 2 的受控研究
abstract_cn: 语言模型是否在某文档上训练过，对版权、隐私与基准污染都很重要。然而多数对语言模型的成员推断（MI）评估在事后收集成员与非成员，成功可能反映分布偏移，失败则无法下结论。我们重跑 OLMo 2 1B 官方的 500 亿 token 中期训练阶段，把选定训练块替换为按领域与难度匹配的 7,814 对文档：每对以掷硬币决定哪篇插入训练、哪篇留出。Allen Institute for AI（AI2）发布的同种子官方跑在其余数据上完全相同，充当反事实参照。一次暴露平均会提升一个此前未见文档的似然，但很少能识别它。以反事实为参照时，参照比值的 ROC 曲线下面积为 0.767，但跨域单一阈值下在 1% 假阳性率仅捕获 3.8% 的成员。相比之下，13 对匹配文档即让配对检验以 5% 水平、80% 功效检测到一个集合上的训练（给定同域非成员与接近的参照）。另一种子训练的参照可恢复反事实 92% 的 AUC 优势，而无参照攻击在跨域合并时距随机不超过 0.07。把完整官方后训练流程在两模型上重跑后，平均效应仍保留 89%。即便有紧密匹配的参照，显著的文档级变异也限制了个体成员推断。我们将发布检查点、逐 token 对数概率与评估文档；代码见 https://github.com/ali-bana/OLMo-Twin。

title: Simple Features Beat Most AI Control Monitors
abstract: AI control relies on monitors to catch a capable model that sabotages its work. These monitors are evaluated on their ability to differentiate honest from backdoored code. We show that on a standard evaluation dataset, simple features beat most monitors without ever running the code, outranking 20 of 24 open-weight models prompted as monitors. The dataset gives its labels away in two ways. People wrote the honest solutions and older language models the backdoors, so the style of the code reveals the class. Additionally, problems that LLMs can backdoor have different characteristics, so basic facts about the problem reveal it too. Swapping one class at a time for code by Claude Sonnet 5 shows that these features reward a contrast between authors, since human code against Sonnet 5's backdoors is easier to separate than the original pairs, 0.95 against 0.79. One in seven backdoors in the standard test set fails our validity checks, which distorts comparisons between attackers. A Sonnet 5 monitor appears to catch 77% of the older models' backdoors but 37% of Sonnet 5's, and 78% against 61% once both are verified. We do not show that published monitors rely on these shortcuts, but our findings suggest that a high score on such a dataset is not by itself evidence of sabotage detection. We release the rebuilt dataset and checks.

title_cn: 简单特征胜过多数 AI 控制监视器
abstract_cn: AI 控制依赖监视器来发现破坏自身工作的强模型。这些监视器以其区分诚实与后门代码的能力评估。我们证明在一个标准评估数据集上，简单特征不运行代码即胜过多数监视器，排名超过 24 个开源权重监视器模型中的 20 个。该数据集以两种方式泄露标签：诚实解由人类编写而后门由较旧语言模型编写，因此代码风格即暴露类别；此外 LLM 能植入后门的问题本身具有不同特征，关于问题的基本事实同样暴露类别。把一类一侧逐个换成 Claude Sonnet 5 的代码表明这些特征奖励的是作者之间的对比：人类代码对 Sonnet 5 后门（0.95）比原始配对（0.79）更易区分。标准测试集中七分之一的后门未通过我们的有效性检查，扭曲了攻击者之间的比较：一个 Sonnet 5 监视器对旧模型后门的检出看似 77%，对 Sonnet 5 自身后门仅 37%，双侧验证后为 78% 对 61%。我们并未证明已发表的监视器依赖这些捷径，但发现表明：在这类数据集上的高分本身不是破坏检测能力的证据。我们发布重建的数据集与检查。

title: Fooling Relying Parties of the EUDI Wallet Architecture: Credential Pooling Attacks and CRESTA, a Standard-Compliant Countermeasure
abstract: The European Digital Identity (EUDI) Wallet will let millions of EU citizens prove who they are and what they are entitled to, disclosing only what is needed. Many services need several credentials at once, such as an identity card and a university degree, so combined presentations are essential. We present credential pooling attacks on relying parties of the EUDI Wallet reference architecture. Colluding users, each holding some credentials in their own wallet, cooperate through a proxy that acts as a single synthetic user and presents all the requested credentials, although no single user holds them all. Every signature is genuine and computed by certified hardware, and nothing is extracted or forged. We ran the attack against the European Commission's reference implementation, also on two Android phones. The attack would fail if all credentials of a user carried the same public key, but colluding relying parties could then link all presentations of that user. For this reason, the Architecture and Reference Framework (ARF) requires a fresh key for each credential and recommends batches of single-use copies, each with its own key: precisely what makes pooling possible. One might think that preventing pooling requires giving up unlinkability or adopting non-standard cryptography, such as zero-knowledge proofs. We show that this is not the case: we present CRESTA (CREdential STApling), an efficient countermeasure that uses only standard cryptography and credential formats and preserves unlinkability. In CRESTA, an ordinary issuer checks at issuance that a set of keys was generated in the same secure hardware, and certifies it in a binding attestation: a standard credential whose attributes can be selectively disclosed. CRESTA works entirely within the EUDI Wallet framework and costs a relying party one additional signature verification per presentation.
title_cn: 愚弄 EUDI 钱包架构的依赖方：凭据池化攻击与符合标准的对策 CRESTA
abstract_cn: 欧洲数字身份（EUDI）钱包将让数百万欧盟公民证明自己是谁、享有什么权利，且只披露必要信息。许多服务需要同时出示多个凭据（如身份证与大学学位），因此组合出示不可或缺。我们提出针对 EUDI 钱包参考架构依赖方的凭据池化攻击：多个各持部分凭据的用户合谋，经一个充当单一合成用户的代理出示全部被请求的凭据，尽管没有任何单一用户集齐。每个签名都真实且由认证硬件计算，没有任何提取或伪造。我们在欧盟委员会参考实现以及两部 Android 手机上实施了该攻击。若用户所有凭据共用同一公钥，攻击即失效，但合谋的依赖方将能链接该用户的所有出示——正因如此，架构与参考框架（ARF）要求每个凭据一把新钥并推荐每钥单次使用的批次拷贝，而这恰恰使池化成为可能。有人会以为阻止池化必须放弃不可链接性或采用零知识证明等非标准密码学。我们证明并非如此：提出 CRESTA（CREdential STApling），一个只用标准密码学与凭据格式、并保留不可链接性的高效对策——常规签发方在签发时检查一组密钥生成于同一安全硬件，并以绑定证明（一个支持选择性披露的标准凭据）加以认证。CRESTA 完全工作于 EUDI 钱包框架内，依赖方每次出示只多验一个签名。
summary_cn: 在欧盟 EUDI 钱包参考实现与真机上实施凭据池化攻击（合谋经代理集齐凭据、全部签名真实），并提出仅用标准密码学、保留不可链接性的对策 CRESTA：签发时认证同硬件密钥绑定，依赖方只多验一个签名。
objective_summary: 提出并实证 EUDI 钱包依赖方的凭据池化攻击，分析其与 ARF 单钥单用设计的张力，提出签发期同硬件密钥绑定认证的 CRESTA 对策并评估开销。

novelty_note: 首次系统提出针对 EUDI 架构组合出示的凭据池化威胁模型，并给出无需放弃不可链接性、无需非标准密码学的合规对策，时机与影响面（欧盟数亿用户）关键。

title: Group Physical-Layer Authentication and Confidential Beamforming in Non-Terrestrial Networks
abstract: Coordinated high-altitude platform station (HAPS) networks need to authenticate group responses and protect private data under shared power constraints. This paper studies joint group physical-layer authentication (PLA) and confidential beamforming using a fresh secret tag superimposed on private data. For received attacks independent of the current tag, we derive exact finite-block expressions for false acceptance and legitimate rejection. These expressions translate authentication error targets into a required tag signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR). We establish a nonzero asymptotic tag-energy floor and analyze residual frequency offset and peak-power restrictions. The legitimate receiver removes the tag by orthogonal projection, which discards one temporal dimension. For colluding eavesdroppers, we identify the spatial coverage condition under which artificial noise (AN) keeps their SINR bounded as data and AN powers increase together. We jointly optimize the private beams, tag beam, and AN covariance to minimize transmit power under authentication, secrecy, and per-HAPS power constraints. The method combines semidefinite relaxation (SDR), exact private-beam rank reduction, and feasible successive convex approximation. A corrected dual lower bound measures the remaining optimality gap. Numerical results show that increasing the tag length from 16 to 64 symbols reduces the required tag SINR by 7.16 dB. Joint beam design reduces mean transmit power by 27.4% relative to an optimized fixed-tag-direction baseline. The authentication guarantee requires fresh secret tags and excludes relays of the current response.
title_cn: 非地面网络中的群组物理层认证与保密波束成形
abstract_cn: 协同的高空平台站（HAPS）网络需要在共享功率约束下认证群组响应并保护私有数据。本文研究联合群组物理层认证（PLA）与保密波束成形，把新鲜密标签叠加在私有数据上。对与当前标签无关的接收攻击，我们推导错误接受与合法拒绝的精确有限块长表达式；这些表达式把认证错误目标转化为所需的标签信干噪比（SINR）。我们确立非零的渐近标签能量下限，并分析残余频偏与峰值功率限制。合法接收端用正交投影去除标签，代价是丢弃一个时间维度。对合谋窃听者，我们识别人工噪声（AN）在数据与 AN 功率同步增长时仍把其 SINR 压在有界的空间覆盖条件。我们联合优化私有波束、标签波束与 AN 协方差，在认证、保密与每 HAPS 功率约束下最小化发射功率。方法结合半定松弛（SDR）、精确的私有波束降秩与可行的逐次凸逼近，并用修正的对偶下界度量剩余最优性间隙。数值结果表明：标签长度从 16 增到 64 符号把所需标签 SINR 降低 7.16 dB；联合波束设计相对优化的固定标签方向基线把平均发射功率降低 27.4%。认证保证要求新鲜密标签且排除当前响应的中继。
summary_cn: HAPS 群组物理层认证 + 保密波束成形：推导精确有限块长认证错误表达式（标签 16→64 符号省 7.16 dB SINR），联合优化私有/标签/AN 波束使平均发射功率降 27.4%。
objective_summary: 对叠加密标签的群组物理层认证推导有限块长错误表达式与 SINR 需求，联合优化私有/标签/AN 波束并刻画合谋窃听者的有界 SINR 条件。
evidence_note: 精确有限块长表达式推导 + 修正对偶下界 + 数值优化验证（7.16 dB、27.4% 等量化结果）；无实测，无会议信息。
novelty_note: 群组 PLA 与保密波束成形的联合设计在 HAPS 场景属较新组合；成分技术（叠加标签、AN、SDR/降秩/SCA）为已有方法的系统化改造。
scope: 结论适用于 HAPS 协同网络的物理层认证与保密传输设计；要求新鲜密标签，不含中继当前响应的场景。
limitations: 全部为数值仿真，无实测或信道测量验证；正交投影丢一维的速率代价未详估；敌手模型限于与当前标签无关的接收攻击与合谋窃听。

title: Poly Versus Polyval
abstract: We revisit the basic construction of polynomial evaluation based hash function, which we call Poly, over binary extension fields over $GF(2^n)$, where $n=64k$ and $k\geq 2$. Unlike GHASH, the NIST standard polynomial evaluation based hash function for $n=128$, Poly does not perform the unnecessary bit reversals of each $n$-bit block, and consequently is faster than GHASH. Further, Poly differs from Polyval, -- a faster alternative to GHASH, -- in that Poly performs usual reduction, while Polyval performs Montgomery reduction. We identify suitable choices of the field representing irreducible polynomials which makes usual and Montgomery reductions efficient. We provide detailed algorithms, and associated proofs of correctness for both kinds of reductions. Based on the algorithms, we report carefully optimised assembly implementation of both Poly and Polyval for $n=128,256$ and $512$. Our theoretical analysis and experimental timing results show that for $n=128$, Polyval is faster than Poly, while for $n=256$ and $512$ (as well as for higher values of $n$), Poly is faster than Polyval. The cases $n=128$ and $256$ are of current relevance due to the ongoing NIST process for developing cryptographic accordions.
title_cn: Poly 对 Polyval
abstract_cn: 我们重新审视基于 GF(2^n)（n = 64k，k ≥ 2）二元扩域上多项式求值的哈希函数基本构造，称之为 Poly。与 n = 128 的 NIST 标准多项式求值哈希 GHASH 不同，Poly 不对每个 n 位块做本可省去的位反转，因而比 GHASH 更快；与 GHASH 的更快替代 Polyval 不同，Poly 执行常规约减，而 Polyval 执行 Montgomery 约减。我们找出了使常规与 Montgomery 约减都高效的域表示不可约多项式的合适选择，给出两类约减的详细算法与正确性证明。基于这些算法，我们报告针对 n = 128、256 与 512 的 Poly 与 Polyval 的精心优化的汇编实现。理论分析与实验计时表明：n = 128 时 Polyval 快于 Poly，而 n = 256 与 512（以及更大的 n）时 Poly 快于 Polyval。n = 128 与 256 两种情形因 NIST 正在进行的密码学手风琴（accordion）标准化进程而具有现实意义。
summary_cn: 重审 GF(2^n) 多项式求值哈希：Poly（常规约减）与 Polyval（Montgomery 约减）的理论对比与汇编实现表明 n=128 时 Polyval 更快、n≥256 时 Poly 更快，正对 NIST 手风琴标准化进程。
objective_summary: 分析 GF(2^n) 上常规约减（Poly）与 Montgomery 约减（Polyval）两类多项式求值哈希，给出算法、正确性证明与 n = 128/256/512 的优化汇编实现及计时对比。
evidence_note: 正确性证明 + 精心优化的汇编实现与计时实验，理论与实现闭环；非紧界突破型论文，无会议信息。
novelty_note: Poly 本体是 GHASH 家族的直接变体，新意在于找出使两类约减各自高效的不可约多项式并给出交叉点分析（n=128 对 n≥256），对 NIST 手风琴进程有直接参考价值。
scope: 结论适用于 n = 64k 二元扩域上多项式求值哈希的软件实现选择；硬件实现与抗侧信道考量未涉及。
limitations: 结论限于软件汇编实现与所测平台；安全强度与 GHASH 家族相同（无新安全 claim）；未讨论与 AEAD 模式集成的完整开销。

title: DeepWeave: Weaving Neural and Symbolic Evidence for ML-Based Network Intrusion Detection System
abstract: Machine learning-based network intrusion detection systems can recognize complex traffic patterns, but often require substantial labelled attack data, degrade under deployment shift, and provide limited evidence for analysts. We present DeepWeave, a probabilistic neuro-symbolic Network Intrusion Detection System (NIDS) that makes logic an integral part of detection. DeepWeave automatically constructs and validates interpretable rules, represents neural predictions as probabilistic predicates, and reconciles both evidence sources through explicit coupling policies over packet-, flow-, and hybrid-views. The resulting proofs provide intrinsic explanations for rule-supported alerts. Across multiple datasets, DeepWeave improves low-data detection, false-positive control, transferability, and robustness. With only 50 labelled packet observations per attack class, it improves macro-F1 from 0.632 to 0.924 and reduces the attack false-positive rate from 0.075 to 0.008 over the matched neural baseline. Its proofs are also more stable than post-hoc neural attributions, while batched inference keeps probabilistic reasoning practical. These results demonstrate label-efficient, adaptable, and inspectable neuro-symbolic intrusion detection.
title_cn: DeepWeave：为机器学习网络入侵检测编织神经与符号证据
abstract_cn: 基于机器学习的网络入侵检测系统能识别复杂流量模式，但往往需要大量标注攻击数据、在部署偏移下退化，且给分析员的证据有限。我们提出 DeepWeave，一个概率神经—符号网络入侵检测系统（NIDS），把逻辑作为检测的组成部分。DeepWeave 自动构建并验证可解释规则，把神经预测表示为概率谓词，并通过包级、流级与混合视图上的显式耦合策略调和两类证据来源。所得证明为有规则支撑的告警提供内在解释。在多个数据集上，DeepWeave 改进低数据检测、误报控制、可迁移性与鲁棒性：每攻击类仅 50 条标注包观测时，宏 F1 从匹配神经基线的 0.632 提升到 0.924，攻击误报率从 0.075 降到 0.008。其证明也比事后神经归因更稳定，而批量推理让概率推理保持实用。这些结果表明神经—符号入侵检测可以实现标签高效、可适应且可检视。
summary_cn: 概率神经—符号 NIDS DeepWeave：每类仅 50 条标注观测下宏 F1 从 0.632 提升到 0.924、攻击误报率 0.075→0.008，证明式解释比事后归因更稳定。
objective_summary: 构建以自动验证规则 + 概率谓词 + 显式耦合策略组成的神经—符号 NIDS DeepWeave，在多数据集上量化低数据检测、误报、迁移与解释稳定性。
evidence_note: 多数据集对照匹配神经基线，量化宏 F1 与误报率、含批量推理开销；无统计检验与会议信息，「多数据集」具体规模摘要未列。
novelty_note: 把逻辑规则作为检测的组成部分（而非事后解释层）并以显式耦合策略调和神经/符号证据，在 NIDS 场景属扎实的新组合；神经—符号路线本身已有先例。
scope: 结论适用于包/流级入侵检测与低标注场景；规则库覆盖之外的全新攻击范式与加密流量未评估。
limitations: 规则构建依赖可解释特征空间；耦合策略需人工设定；数据集规模与多样性摘要未详列。

title: GESIS Surf: An Open-Source Infrastructure for Privacy-Preserving Longitudinal Web Browsing Data Collection
abstract: Understanding how people navigate digital media environments requires behavioral data beyond survey self-reports. However, existing infrastructures for collecting such data reproducibly, sustainably, and with strong privacy guarantees remain limited: commercial solutions lack transparency and data governance, while academic tools are typically designed for narrow, short-term use cases and do not support general-purpose academic panel data collections. We address this gap with GESIS Surf, a research infrastructure for large-scale longitudinal collection of web behavioral data in naturalistic environments. The system consists of a browser extension (Chrome and Firefox), a backend with a REST application programming interface (API), and a relational database. It passively captures user interactions, page metadata, and full HTML snapshots of each rendered page, embedding each observation within a hierarchical session model that preserves the structure of browsing behavior. GESIS Surf implements privacy-by-design through strict opt-in participation, per-domain collection rules, and client-side data minimization, ensuring that sensitive data are controlled at the point of collection. The system has been deployed with more than 1,000 participants in a large-scale academic panel infrastructure that includes surveys of participants, and supports reproducible, content-level, and structurally rich analysis of digital behavior. By combining hierarchical session modeling, content-level capture, and integrated privacy enforcement within a unified system, GESIS Surf provides a general-purpose infrastructure for studying digital behavior in a reproducible manner over time.

title_cn: GESIS Surf：面向隐私保护的纵向网络浏览数据采集的开源基础设施

title: When Safety Checks Become Privacy Risks: A Privacy-Preserving Paradigm for LLM Agent Safety Auditing
abstract: Large language model agents interact with online services through tool calls that may access private data or perform sensitive actions. Specialized providers can supply and maintain pre-execution safety auditing capabilities for agent operators. However, sending task descriptions, call arguments, and interaction histories to an external auditor may expose sensitive user information. In this work, we propose a paradigm for privacy-preserving safety auditing that separates delegated audit computation from plaintext access and execution authority. Grounded in a three-domain auditing model, the paradigm connects trusted representation construction, encrypted audit computation, and trusted decision and execution through explicit interfaces. These interfaces accommodate alternative representations and scorers, while encrypted computation protects audit inputs from a semi-honest auditor. We instantiate this paradigm in SealCall, a framework combining learned audit representations, CKKS-based encrypted similarity computation, and execution control bound to audited tool calls. Evaluated on 1,252 public binary candidates, SealCall achieves a mean F1 score of 0.840 under grouped nested evaluation, while preserving plaintext audit decisions in all measured cases. A representative configuration completes each encrypted scoring operation in 0.176 s.
title_cn: 当安全检查成为隐私风险：面向 LLM 智能体安全审计的隐私保护范式
abstract_cn: 大语言模型智能体通过可能访问私有数据或执行敏感操作的工具调用与在线服务交互。专业服务商可以为智能体运营方提供并维护执行前安全审计能力。然而，把任务描述、调用参数与交互历史发送给外部审计方可能暴露敏感用户信息。本工作提出一种隐私保护安全审计范式，把受委托的审计计算与明文访问及执行权限分离。该范式立足三域审计模型，通过显式接口连接可信表示构建、加密审计计算与可信决策执行；这些接口容纳替代表示与评分器，加密计算保护审计输入免受半诚实审计方窥视。我们在 SealCall 中实例化该范式：结合学习到的审计表示、基于 CKKS 的加密相似度计算、以及与被审计工具调用绑定的执行控制。在 1,252 个公开二分类候选上，SealCall 在分组嵌套评估下取得平均 F1 0.840，同时所有测量用例中保留明文审计决策；一个代表性配置完成每次加密评分操作用时 0.176 秒。
summary_cn: 把智能体安全审计与明文访问分离的范式 SealCall：学习表示 + CKKS 加密相似度 + 绑定执行的审计控制，1,252 候选上平均 F1 0.840，单次加密评分 0.176 秒。
objective_summary: 提出三域分离的隐私保护安全审计范式并以 SealCall 实例化（学习表示 + CKKS 加密相似度 + 执行控制），在公开候选集上量化审计 F1 与加密开销。
evidence_note: 1,252 个公开候选、分组嵌套评估，报告 F1 与单次加密评分时延；评估集较专（二分类候选）、无统计检验与会议信息。
novelty_note: 「审计计算与明文访问分离」的范式化表述 + 半诚实审计方威胁模型较新；CKKS、学习表示等构件为已有技术的应用组合。
scope: 结论适用于把审计外包给第三方服务商的智能体运营场景；限于半诚实审计方与二分类审计决策。
limitations: 加密计算带来时延开销；审计表示的学习质量决定 F1 上限；未覆盖恶意审计方与更复杂的多级审计决策。

title: BlindStep: A Secure One-Step Kernel for Privacy-Preserving Collaborative Reasoning
abstract: A recurring step in two-party collaborative workflows combines a private candidate frontier with a partner's compatible evidence, scores the resulting candidates, and retains only a small frontier. Direct execution can expose intermediate candidates, local scores, or unauthorized evidence provenance. Existing MPC platforms and PSI protocols provide useful building blocks, but they do not define a unified post-alignment boundary for bounded-slot aggregation, fail-closed overflow handling, retained-frontier selection, and downstream disclosure. We present BlindStep, a fixed-shape MPC-online kernel for one such post-alignment step between two semi-honest parties. Given a frontend realizing the bounded-slot contract and an application enforcing the reveal policy $\rho$, BlindStep provides a per-invocation simulation-based guarantee in the $F_{\mathrm{align}}$-hybrid model: the kernel leaks only public setup parameters, fixed execution-shape metadata, a global overflow bit, and $\rho$-authorized Layer-2 disclosures. The guarantee excludes malicious security and multi-invocation composition, and treats frontend leakage and offline preprocessing separately. Within this kernel boundary, we implement six semi2k realizations in MP-SPDZ, crossing two sharing styles and three top-K strategies: H-variants compare over arithmetic shares, while B-variants convert packed ranking values to Boolean shares before selection. Under LAN, B-Queue is 6-7 times faster and uses about 40 times less communication than H-Queue at N = 256 and 2048. Against H-Sort on the same backend, B-Queue achieves speedups of 21 and 30 times and communication reductions of 204 and 290 times at N = 2048 and 8192, respectively. Under the evaluated N = 256, 100 ms RTT WAN profile, H-Sort becomes fastest, showing that round complexity can dominate backend choice for the measured MPC-online kernel.

title_cn: BlindStep：面向隐私保护协同推理的安全单步内核
abstract_cn: 两方协同工作流中反复出现的一步是：把私有候选前沿与对方的兼容证据结合、为所得候选打分、只保留一个小前沿。直接执行会暴露中间候选、本地分数或未授权的证据来源。现有 MPC 平台与 PSI 协议提供有用构件，但未为有界槽位聚合、故障即失败的溢出处理、保留前沿选择与下游披露定义统一的对齐后边界。我们提出 BlindStep，一个面向两个半诚实方之间对齐后单步的固定形状 MPC 在线内核。给定实现有界槽位契约的前端与执行披露策略 rho 的应用，BlindStep 在 F_align-hybrid 模型中提供每次调用的基于仿真的保证：内核只泄露公开设置参数、固定执行形状元数据、一个全局溢出位与 rho 授权的 Layer-2 披露。该保证不包含恶意安全与多次调用组合，并把前端泄露与离线预处理分开处理。在该内核边界内，我们在 MP-SPDZ 中实现六个 semi2k 方案，跨越两种分享风格与三种 top-K 策略：H 变体在算术份额上比较，B 变体在 选择前把打包排序值转为布尔份额。在 LAN 下，N = 256 与 2048 时 B-Queue 比 H-Queue 快 6–7 倍、通信约省 40 倍；同一后端上对比 H-Sort，B-Queue 在 N = 2048 与 8192 时分别取得 21 与 30 倍加速、204 与 290 倍通信缩减。在评估的 N = 256、100 ms RTT WAN 档位下，H-Sort 变为最快，表明对所测 MPC 在线内核而言轮次复杂度可以主导后端选择。（ACSAC 2026 录用）
summary_cn: 半诚实两方 MPC 在线内核 BlindStep：六种 semi2k 实现（MP-SPDZ），LAN 下 B-Queue 比 H-Queue 快 6–7 倍、省约 40 倍通信，WAN 下 H-Sort 反超，揭示轮次复杂度主导后端选择（ACSAC 2026）。
objective_summary: 定义两方协同推理中对齐后单步的 MPC 内核边界并给出每次调用的仿真安全保证，在 MP-SPDZ 中实现六种方案并系统测量 LAN/WAN 下的时间与通信。
evidence_note: ACSAC 2026 录用；形式化的 F_align-hybrid 模型安全定义 + 六种实现的系统性能对照（LAN/WAN、多 N 值）；恶意安全明确不在保证范围内。
novelty_note: 把「对齐后聚合—打分—截断」抽象为带明确泄露边界的可复用内核是新的形式化贡献；实现构件（算术/布尔分享、top-K 策略）为已有技术。
scope: 结论适用于半诚实两方、单次调用、前端满足有界槽位契约的 MPC 在线步骤；不含恶意安全与多调用组合。
limitations: 仅半诚实模型；泄漏边界不覆盖前端与离线预处理；性能结论依赖所测参数档位（N、RTT）。

title: Efficient cross-domain multi-factor authentication
abstract: Secure cross-domain authentication is crucial for protecting information exchange across terminals in different security domains. However, existing cross-domain authentication models suffer from inflexibility, high storage and computational consumption. In response to these problems, a cross-domain multi-factor authentication protocol with improved efficiency (CDAuth) is proposed. CDAuth employs a universally applicable multi-factor authentication approach, integrating pseudo-identity, attribute concealment, and biometric hiding. The authentication information sets can be freely added or modified to accommodate various access scenarios. This boosts privacy, flexibility, and applicability compared to traditional methods. Furthermore, multi-edge servers as Certification Authorities (CAs) store only the union of terminal attributes and a verification token per user in their subdomains, instead of each user's attribute and biometric sets as in traditional schemes, significantly reducing storage consumption. Additionally, replacing the bilinear pairing operations with the native group operations, while maintaining security, significantly reduces computational consumption. Our analysis shows that CDAuth can resist common security attacks and is more efficient than the previous schemes.
title_cn: 高效的跨域多因素认证
abstract_cn: 安全的跨域认证对保护不同安全域终端之间的信息交换至关重要。然而现有跨域认证模型不灵活、存储与计算开销高。针对这些问题，提出一种效率改进的跨域多因素认证协议 CDAuth。CDAuth 采用普遍适用的多因素认证方法，集成伪身份、属性隐藏与生物特征隐藏；认证信息集可自由增改以适配各种接入场景，相比传统方法提升隐私性、灵活性与适用性。此外，多个边缘服务器作为证书机构（CA），其子域中只存储终端属性的并集与每用户一个验证令牌，而非传统方案中每个用户的属性与生物特征集，显著降低存储消耗；同时以原生群运算替代双线性配对运算，在保持安全性的同时显著降低计算消耗。分析表明 CDAuth 能抵抗常见安全攻击，且比以往方案更高效。
summary_cn: 跨域多因素认证协议 CDAuth：伪身份 + 属性/生物特征隐藏，边缘 CA 只存属性并集与单验证令牌，用原生群运算替代双线性配对，自称更省存储与计算并抗常见攻击。
objective_summary: 提出集成伪身份、属性隐藏与生物特征隐藏的跨域多因素认证协议 CDAuth，以边缘 CA 存储优化与配对消除降低存储和计算开销，并做安全性分析。
evidence_note: 以安全性与效率的分析论证为主，摘要未给出实现测量数字，无会议信息；典型的协议设计 + 分析型论文。
novelty_note: 跨域多因素认证方案众多，CDAuth 的改进（存储结构优化、配对替代）属成熟路线上的增量效率改进。
scope: 结论适用于多安全域终端接入场景的认证协议设计；适用性论证限于分析层面。
limitations: 无实现与实测性能；生物特征隐藏的安全性依赖标准假设；威胁模型覆盖「常见攻击」但未含自适应或量子攻击者。

title: OrionLink: Single Sign-On with Oblivious Identity Brokers
abstract: Single Sign-On (SSO) is a federated authentication mechanism that improves user experience by enabling access to multiple services, or Relying Parties (RPs), through a single authentication at an Identity Provider (IdP). To reduce integration complexity, many RPs rely on third-party Identity Brokers (Brokers) that aggregate numerous IdPs into a unified interface, thereby simplifying protocol management and interoperability. However, while brokers ease development, they introduce a fundamental security and privacy risk: sensitive authentication credentials and user behavioral data are exposed to the broker, creating a high-value single point of failure. Existing SSO solutions provide limited protection against these risks. With the goal of achieving broker obliviousness, we address these challenges at their root and present OrionLink, a comprehensive privacy-enhancing SSO pipeline that is compatible with existing brokered SSO architectures and systematically mitigates broker-induced risks without sacrificing usability. OrionLink incorporates two core components: (a) an anonymous pseudonym derivation scheme that generates unlinkable, per-RP identifiers to prevent cross-service user tracking; (b) an anonymous key exchange protocol that establishes end-to-end encrypted channels to protect user data from broker visibility. We further instantiate OrionLink with two new features, preserving broker functionality and deployability. We implemented a prototype of OrionLink within a brokered SSO environment, and experimental evaluation shows that the framework achieves substantial security and privacy improvements with acceptable performance overhead.
title_cn: OrionLink：基于遗忘身份中介的单点登录
abstract_cn: 单点登录（SSO）是一种联邦认证机制，用户只需在身份提供商（IdP）认证一次即可访问多个服务（依赖方，RP），从而改善体验。为降低集成复杂度，许多 RP 依赖第三方身份中介（Broker）把众多 IdP 聚合为统一接口，简化协议管理与互操作。然而中介在便利开发的同时引入根本性的安全与隐私风险：敏感认证凭据与用户行为数据暴露给中介，形成高价值单点故障。现有 SSO 方案对这类风险保护有限。以实现中介遗忘为目标，我们从根源入手，提出 OrionLink——一个与既有中介式 SSO 架构兼容、在不牺牲可用性的前提下系统缓解中介风险的全面隐私增强 SSO 流水线。OrionLink 包含两个核心组件：(a) 匿名假名派生方案，生成不可链接的每 RP 标识以防跨服务用户追踪；(b) 匿名密钥交换协议，建立端到端加密信道，保护用户数据免受中介窥视。我们进一步以两个新特性实例化 OrionLink，保留中介功能与可部署性。我们在中介式 SSO 环境中实现原型，实验评估表明该框架以可接受的开销取得实质的安全与隐私改进。
summary_cn: 面向身份中介泄露风险的隐私增强 SSO 流水线 OrionLink：不可链接的每 RP 假名派生 + 匿名密钥交换建立端到端加密，兼容既有中介架构并以可接受开销实现。
objective_summary: 针对第三方身份中介暴露凭据与行为数据的风险，提出兼容既有中介式 SSO 的 OrionLink：每 RP 不可链接假名与匿名密钥交换，并实现原型评估开销。
evidence_note: 中介式 SSO 环境中的原型实现与实验评估，报告安全/隐私改进与可接受开销；摘要未列具体性能数字与形式化证明，无会议信息，25 页篇幅。
novelty_note: 「中介遗忘」作为中介式 SSO 的设计目标较新；组件（假名派生、匿名密钥交换）源于已有密码学构件，贡献在新场景的系统组合与可部署性设计。
scope: 结论适用于采用第三方身份中介的 SSO 部署；不改变 IdP/RP 自身的信任假设，中介主动作恶的更强威胁未完全覆盖。
limitations: 性能开销「可接受」的具体量化摘要未给出；对恶意中介的防御依赖加密信道端点安全；未报告与现有方案的端到端兼容性测试规模。

title: Erase the Injected Region: Multimodal Prompt-Injection Defense with On-Policy Self-Distillation
abstract: Multimodal indirect prompt injection embeds malicious instructions in external media that also contains information needed for the user's task. Existing defenses can block the attack yet impair the model's use of that information, leaving a gap between attack defense and task preservation. We propose ERASE, an on-policy self-distillation method that constructs its reference by erasing the injected region in place. Modality-appropriate blank content replaces the injection while the surrounding media is preserved. A student reading attacked media learns from a frozen base model reading the erased view through full-distribution token-level feedback on its own rollouts. Across image, audio, and video on two model sizes, ERASE records near-zero observed attack success on the evaluated benchmark while retaining task utility close to the undefended clean-input level. On 3B audio, ERASE reaches 60.1% attacked-input accuracy compared with ARGUS's 33.1%, within 0.5 points of the undefended clean-input level. Experiments show that ERASE reduces injection dependence from 6.26 to 0.0095 on 3B audio while staying close to the base model on the erased input. Out-of-domain accuracy also stays near the base level. Our code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
title_cn: 擦除注入区域：基于在线策略自蒸馏的多模态提示注入防御
abstract_cn: 多模态间接提示注入把恶意指令嵌入同时承载任务所需信息的外部媒体中。现有防御能阻断攻击，却损害模型对该信息的利用，在攻击防御与任务保全之间留下缺口。我们提出 ERASE，一种在线策略自蒸馏方法：通过就地擦除注入区域来构造参考——用模态恰当的空白内容替换注入、保留周围媒体。读取受攻击媒体的学生模型，从读取擦除视图的冻结基座模型获得其自身 rollout 上的全分布 token 级反馈。在图像、音频与视频及两个模型规模上，ERASE 在所评基准上取得近零的观测攻击成功，同时任务效用接近无防御的干净输入水平。在 3B 音频上，ERASE 受攻击输入准确率达 60.1%（ARGUS 为 33.1%），距无防御干净输入水平 0.5 个百分点以内。实验表明 ERASE 把 3B 音频的注入依赖从 6.26 降到 0.0095，同时在擦除输入上与基座模型保持接近。域外准确率也保持在基座水平附近。代码将在录用后公开。
summary_cn: 自蒸馏防御 ERASE 就地擦除注入区域构造参考视图：图像/音频/视频上观测攻击成功近零，3B 音频受攻击输入准确率 60.1%（ARGUS 33.1%），距干净水平 0.5 个百分点内。
objective_summary: 提出以擦除注入区域为参考视图的在线策略自蒸馏防御 ERASE，在图像/音频/视频与两个模型规模上量化攻击成功、任务效用与注入依赖的变化。
evidence_note: 三种模态 × 两个模型规模的系统评估，与 ARGUS 等对照并量化注入依赖（6.26→0.0095）；无统计检验与会议信息，代码承诺公开。
novelty_note: 「擦除注入区域作为蒸馏参考」是兼顾防御与任务保全的新机制，绕开既有防御阻断攻击即损效用的两难。
scope: 结论适用于可定位注入区域的多模态媒体；注入区域不可定位或注入与任务内容耦合的场景未覆盖。
limitations: 依赖能构造擦除视图的注入定位假设；评估限于已公开基准；代码未随论文发布（承诺录用后公开）。

title: ANGLER: Verifier-Grounded Benchmarking with an Adaptive Attacker for Web Agents
abstract: Web agents are increasingly deployed to complete tasks autonomously on real websites, where adversarially injected content can induce them to perform unauthorized actions. Existing evaluations primarily use fixed attacks or focus on a single attack type, and evaluate attacks at the text level rather than through real state changes, thus underestimating how vulnerable agents are to diverse attacks. To address the gap, we introduce REEF, a benchmark of red-teaming executable environments with faithful verification for measuring the security vulnerabilities of web agents. REEF covers 9 verifier-grounded websites spanning travel, commerce, productivity, media, and communication, and pairs every authentic benign task with a malicious objective delivered through 5 attack types at both the user and the environment level. REEF's state-based verifiers provide the execution feedback that drives ANGLER, an adaptive near-miss-guided lure evolution framework for red-teaming. Rather than evaluating a fixed attack set, ANGLER uses outcomes from prior rollouts to guide LLM-based attack mutation and candidate selection, prioritizing near-miss seeds during refinement. Across 8 VLM-based web agents, ANGLER achieves an end-to-end attack success rate (ASR) of 20.36%, compared with 15.24% for the non-adaptive setting. Compared with attack-free execution on the same benign tasks, attacks generated by ANGLER reduce benign task success rate (BSR) from 61.9% to 44.4%.
title_cn: ANGLER：面向 Web 智能体的验证器锚定基准与自适应攻击者
abstract_cn: Web 智能体越来越多地被部署在真实网站上自主完成任务，而对抗性注入的内容可诱使其实施未授权操作。现有评估主要使用固定攻击或聚焦单一攻击类型，且在文本层面而非通过真实状态改变评估攻击，从而低估了智能体面对多样攻击的脆弱性。为填补缺口，我们提出 REEF，一个以可执行红队环境与忠实验证来度量 Web 智能体安全漏洞的基准。REEF 覆盖旅行、电商、生产力、媒体与通信领域的 9 个以验证器锚定的网站，为每个真实良性任务配对经由用户与环境两级、5 种攻击类型投递的恶意目标。REEF 的基于状态的验证器提供执行反馈，驱动 ANGLER——一个自适应的、以「险些得手」为引导的诱饵演化红队框架。不同于评估固定攻击集，ANGLER 利用先前 rollout 的结果引导基于 LLM 的攻击变异与候选选择，在精炼时优先险些得手的种子。在 8 个基于 VLM 的 Web 智能体上，ANGLER 端到端攻击成功率达 20.36%，非自适应设定为 15.24%。与同批良性任务的无攻击执行相比，ANGLER 生成的攻击把良性任务成功率从 61.9% 压到 44.4%。
summary_cn: REEF 基准以 9 个验证器锚定网站 + 状态级真值评估 Web 智能体安全，配套自适应攻击框架 ANGLER：8 个 VLM 智能体上端到端 ASR 20.36%（非自适应 15.24%），良性任务成功率 61.9%→44.4%。
objective_summary: 构建以状态验证器提供忠实攻击判定与执行反馈的 REEF 基准，并提出以险些得手种子引导 LLM 攻击变异的 ANGLER 框架，在 8 个 VLM 智能体上量化自适应攻击增益。
evidence_note: 9 个自建网站环境 × 8 个 VLM 智能体、状态级验证器取代文本匹配、报告 ASR 与 BSR；基准自建、无统计检验与会议信息。
novelty_note: 以真实状态改变取代文本级攻击判定、以验证器反馈驱动自适应攻击演化，是对 Web 智能体安全评估范式的实质性升级，方向上属首个系统化组合。
scope: 结论适用于可执行 Web 环境中的智能体注入威胁评估；9 个站点域之外的真实网站与防御部署未覆盖。
limitations: 环境为自建模拟站点，与真实网站的反爬/结构差异可能影响迁移；攻击演化依赖 VLM 变异质量；未评估防御侧缓解。

title: When AI Investigators Cannot Trust Their Tools: Conflict-Aware Evidence Verification for Cyber Threat Investigation
abstract: LLM agents increasingly triage security alerts by combining the outputs of several detection tools, implicitly treating those tools as trustworthy. Unlike prior work on conflicts between a model's knowledge and its context, we study conflicts among the tools themselves: what happens when this machine-generated evidence is conflicting or wrong. On the corrected CIC-IDS2017 dataset, four heterogeneous detectors emit labels and confidences that we corrupt under a threat model varying the number of corrupted tools, the persistence of the corruption, and the confidence attached to wrong outputs. Across open-weight LLMs from 3B to 14B parameters, unverified investigators are fragile: one corrupted detector out of four lowers naive accuracy to .50-.72, three lower every unverified investigator to .13 or less, and honest disagreement alone makes them abstain on up to 63% of flows. We propose Conflict-Aware Evidence Verification (CAV), built from established components: an equal-weight vote that ignores reported confidences, an evidence-conflict gate, and an independent nearest-neighbour trust check that tests the leading candidates. With its prompt frozen before testing, CAV-LLM improves on the naive investigator in every corrupted condition ($p < 0.001$), reaching .84-.88 with three corrupted detectors against at most .08, while calling the LLM on 0.4% of clean traffic. A fixed verification rule is as accurate or better unless most tools are corrupted. When we make the independent channel itself noisy, CAV inherits its errors: it stays ahead when two or more tools are corrupted, but adding the channel as an extra voter is better when at most one is. Verification thus moves trust from the tools to the check, which must be measured and protected in turn.

title_cn: 当 AI 调查员无法信任其工具：面向网络威胁调查的冲突感知证据核验
abstract_cn: LLM 智能体日益通过组合多个检测工具的输出来分诊安全告警，并隐式假定这些工具可信。与已有工作研究模型自身知识与上下文的冲突不同，我们研究工具之间的冲突：当这些机器生成的证据相互矛盾或出错时会发生什么。在修正后的 CIC-IDS2017 数据集上，四个异构检测器输出标签与置信度，我们在一个可变损坏工具数量、损坏持续性与错误输出置信度的威胁模型下对其投毒。在 3B 到 14B 的开源权重 LLM 上，未核验的调查员是脆弱的：四个工具中一个被损坏就把朴素准确率压到 0.50–0.72，三个被损坏则所有未核验调查员降至 0.13 以下，而仅诚实的分歧就能让它们在至多 63% 的流上弃权。我们提出冲突感知证据核验（CAV），由成熟组件构成：忽略报告置信度的等权投票、证据冲突门，以及检验领先候选的独立最近邻信任检查。在测试前冻结提示的条件下，CAV-LLM 在每个损坏条件下都显著优于朴素调查员（p < 0.001），三个工具被损坏时达到 0.84–0.88 对至多 0.08，同时只对 0.4% 的干净流量调用 LLM。固定的核验规则在多数工具未被损坏时同样准确甚至更好。当独立通道本身带噪时，CAV 继承其错误：两个及以上工具被损坏时保持领先，而至多一个被损坏时把该通道作为额外投票者更好。核验由此把信任从工具转移到检查本身——后者也必须被度量与保护。
summary_cn: 研究检测工具互相冲突时 LLM 告警调查的脆弱性：四工具中三个被损坏即让未核验调查员准确率跌破 0.13；冻结提示的 CAV（等权投票 + 冲突门 + 独立信任检查）达 0.84–0.88 且仅对 0.4% 干净流量调 LLM（p<0.001）。
objective_summary: 在可控损坏威胁模型下量化检测工具间冲突对 LLM 威胁调查的影响，提出由等权投票、冲突门与最近邻信任检查组成的 CAV 核验机制并做统计检验。
evidence_note: 修正版 CIC-IDS2017、四工具受控损坏、3B–14B 多模型、p < 0.001 统计检验与调用成本量化；ACSAC 2026 Workshop（WAITI）录用。
novelty_note: 把「工具间冲突」从模型—上下文冲突中独立出来系统研究是新的问题刻画；CAV 由成熟组件构成、论文亦如实定位为组合式方案。
scope: 结论适用于多检测器告警分诊与调查场景；限于一个 IDS 数据集与四工具设定，未覆盖多源异构情报流。
limitations: 单一数据集（修正版 CIC-IDS2017）；独立信任通道被损坏时 CAV 继承其错误；提示虽冻结但核验规则需要针对部署环境校准。

title: AgentShield: Fortifying Web Applications Against AI Agents and Agentic Browsers
abstract: LLM-powered browser agents are transforming web automation by autonomously interacting with websites and executing complex workflows. However, the effectiveness of existing anti-bot defenses against these systems remains unclear. We present a systematic empirical evaluation of modern agentic browsers against widely deployed anti-bot mechanisms, characterizing their capabilities, limitations, and behavioral differences from humans. Our results show that many defenses designed for traditional automation struggle to reliably detect autonomous AI-driven agents. Accordingly, we introduce AgentShield, a behavioral fingerprinting framework that targets the Perception-Reasoning-Action (PRA) loop underlying agentic user clients. By leveraging dynamic web forms that progressively reveal content and capture fine-grained interaction telemetry, AgentShield exposes behavioral artifacts that enable differentiation between human users and autonomous agents. We further demonstrate Extinction-induced Policy Drift (EPD), a novel attack in which repeated obstruction of task completion causes agents to relax their safeguards and engage in unsafe behaviors. Finally, we present defensive prompt injection techniques that exploit agent-specific weaknesses to mitigate emerging forms of autonomous web abuse that rely on content extraction. Our results highlight both the shortcomings of current web defenses against agentic user clients and the feasibility of practical detection mechanisms tailored to this new generation of web automation.
comment: To appear in Proceedings of IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy Oakland (IEEE S&P 2027)
title_cn: AgentShield：强化 Web 应用对 AI 智能体与智能体浏览器的防御
abstract_cn: LLM 驱动的浏览器智能体正在通过自主与网站交互、执行复杂工作流来变革 Web 自动化。然而现有反机器人防御对这类系统的效果仍不清楚。我们对现代智能体浏览器针对广泛部署的反爬机制做了系统的实证评估，刻画其能力、局限以及与人类的行为差异。结果表明，许多为传统自动化设计的防御难以可靠检测自主 AI 驱动的智能体。据此我们提出 AgentShield，一个针对智能体用户客户端背后感知—推理—行动（PRA）回路的行为指纹框架：利用渐进式揭示内容并捕捉细粒度交互遥测的动态 Web 表单，AgentShield 暴露可区分人类用户与自主智能体的行为伪迹。我们进一步演示灭绝诱导的策略漂移（EPD）——一种新攻击：反复阻挠任务完成会使智能体放松自身安全防护并实施不安全行为。最后，我们提出防御性提示注入技术，利用智能体特有弱点缓解依赖内容抽取的新兴自主 Web 滥用。结果凸显了现有 Web 防御对智能体用户客户端的不足，以及为这一代 Web 自动化定制实际检测机制的可行性。
summary_cn: 系统评估智能体浏览器对现有反爬机制的绕过能力，提出针对 PRA 回路的行为指纹框架 AgentShield，并揭示反复阻挠会使智能体放松安全防护的灭绝诱导策略漂移（EPD）新攻击（IEEE S&P 2027）。
objective_summary: 实证刻画智能体浏览器对主流反爬机制的行为差异，提出基于动态表单遥测的 PRA 回路行为指纹检测 AgentShield，并演示 EPD 攻击与防御性注入两类攻防技术。
evidence_note: IEEE S&P 2027 录用；对广泛部署反爬机制的系统实证评估 + 检测框架与攻击的技术验证；摘要未列具体检测率数字。
novelty_note: 把检测对象从流量特征转向智能体 PRA 回路的行为伪迹，并首次刻画「反复阻挠导致智能体自放松防护」的 EPD 攻击，攻防两侧均为新机制。
scope: 结论适用于智能体浏览器与内容抽取型自主 Web 滥用场景；对完全拟人化交互或人类代理中转的规避未评估。
limitations: 行为指纹依赖渐进式表单等站点端改造，部署成本由网站承担；EPD 的攻击面限于安全防护可被模型自身放松的智能体；长期军备竞赛未模拟。

title: PP-Mark: Provable and Publicly Verifiable Watermarking for Generative AI
abstract: Generative AI models now produce images indistinguishable from real data, making publicly verifiable provenance essential; however, existing watermarking methods become vulnerable to forgeries and adversarial optimization attacks once their detectors are made public. We propose PP-Mark, a provenance framework that anchors lightweight statistical detection to a zero-knowledge proof of the embedding process, ensuring that forged content cannot pass full verification by construction. We establish formal unforgeability under standard cryptographic assumptions and validate PP-Mark against representative baselines across two latent-diffusion models (SD2.1 and SDXL), demonstrating resistance to black-box imprint forgery, white-box optimization, and regeneration attacks while remaining practical for decentralized verification. Code is available at https://github.com/hko920920/PP-Mark_NeurIPS2026
title_cn: PP-Mark：面向生成式 AI 的可证明、可公开验证水印
abstract_cn: 生成式 AI 模型如今能产出与真实数据难以区分的图像，使可公开验证的来源证明变得必要；然而一旦检测器公开，现有水印方法便易受伪造与对抗优化攻击。我们提出 PP-Mark，一个把轻量统计检测锚定到嵌入过程零知识证明的来源框架，从构造上保证伪造内容无法通过完整验证。我们在标准密码学假设下建立形式化不可伪造性，并在两个潜在扩散模型（SD2.1 与 SDXL）上对照代表性基线验证 PP-Mark，展示其对黑盒印记伪造、白盒优化与再生攻击的抵抗，同时在去中心化验证场景下保持实用。代码见 https://github.com/hko920920/PP-Mark_NeurIPS2026。
summary_cn: 把统计水印检测锚定到嵌入过程的零知识证明：标准假设下证明不可伪造性，在 SD2.1 与 SDXL 上抵抗黑盒印记伪造、白盒优化与再生攻击（NeurIPS 2026）。
objective_summary: 提出以零知识证明锚定统计水印检测的 PP-Mark 框架，建立形式化不可伪造性并在两个扩散模型上对照基线验证对三类攻击的抵抗与验证开销。
evidence_note: NeurIPS 2026 录用；标准密码学假设下的形式化证明 + 两个扩散模型 × 三类攻击的基线对照，代码公开。
novelty_note: 首次把公开可验证水印的检测过程锚定到零知识证明、从构造上排除伪造，直接回应「检测器公开即失守」这一结构性弱点，攻击与防御两侧均有实质新意。
scope: 结论适用于潜在扩散图像生成模型的水印验证；证明依赖标准密码学假设，验证去中心化场景的开销以原型测量为准。
limitations: 统计检测层仍可能被移除或削弱（强度—鲁棒性权衡未在摘要量化）；ZK 证明带来额外验证开销；仅评估图像域两个扩散模型。

title: Who Swept My ETH? Uncovering EIP-7702-Based Ether Redirection Attacks on Ethereum
abstract: EIP-7702 introduces a new transaction type that allows Externally Owned Accounts (EOAs) on major EVM-compatible chains to delegate execution to arbitrary contract codes temporarily. While enhancing functionality, this mechanism facilitates a novel threat: the \underline{E}IP-7702-Based \underline{E}ther \underline{R}edirection \underline{A}ttack (EERA). In such an attack, a victim is delegated to a malicious sweeper contract, which automatically redirects incoming ETH transfers to an address controlled by the attacker. As a nascent attack paradigm arising from protocol evolution, the underlying mechanisms and security implications of EERA remain systematically unexplored. To bridge this gap, we provide the first formal analysis of the EERA attack model and propose SweeperHunter, a framework that detects these attacks through transaction analysis. By evaluating transactions from the first ten months following the introduction of EIP-7702 on Ethereum mainnet, we have identified 4,668,209 malicious delegations, 20,443 attack transactions and 508 ETH sweeper contracts, forming the first EERA dataset. Finally, we analyze this attack from both attacker and victim perspectives, derive key insights, and propose corresponding mitigation strategies. We reveal the prevalence of EERA, as approximately 70\% of the observed delegations point toward ETH sweeper contracts. Furthermore, we observe a notable lack of effective responses from victims; specifically, over 600,000 accounts failed to revoke or update their malicious delegations promptly, thereby remaining in a state of vulnerability. Our research is expected to facilitate understanding and mitigation of this emerging threat posed by EIP-7702.
title_cn: 谁卷走了我的 ETH？揭示以太坊上基于 EIP-7702 的以太币重定向攻击
abstract_cn: EIP-7702 引入了一种新交易类型，允许主流 EVM 兼容链上的外部账户（EOA）临时把执行委托给任意合约代码。它在增强功能的同时，也促生了一种新威胁：基于 EIP-7702 的以太币重定向攻击（EERA）。在此类攻击中，受害者被委托给一个恶意清扫合约，后者自动把转入的 ETH 重定向到攻击者控制的地址。作为协议演化催生的新攻击范式，EERA 的机制与安全影响此前未被系统研究。为弥补这一缺口，我们首次对 EERA 攻击模型做形式化分析，并提出通过交易分析检测此类攻击的 SweeperHunter 框架。通过评估 EIP-7702 在以太坊主网推出后头十个月的交易，我们识别出 4,668,209 个恶意委托、20,443 笔攻击交易与 508 个 ETH 清扫合约，构成首个 EERA 数据集。我们进而从攻击者与受害者双视角分析该攻击，提炼关键洞见并提出缓解策略。我们揭示 EERA 的流行程度：约 70% 的被观察委托指向 ETH 清扫合约；同时受害者明显缺乏有效响应——超过 600,000 个账户未能及时撤销或更新其恶意委托，持续处于易受攻击状态。本研究有望促进对 EIP-7702 所催生新威胁的理解与缓解。
summary_cn: 首次形式化 EIP-7702 以太币重定向攻击（EERA）并提出 SweeperHunter：主网头十个月识别 466.8 万恶意委托、2.04 万攻击交易与 508 个清扫合约，约 70% 委托指向清扫合约，60 万余账户未及时撤销。
objective_summary: 形式化 EERA 攻击模型，构建基于交易分析的 SweeperHunter 检测框架，在 EIP-7702 上线后十个月的主网数据上量化恶意委托、攻击交易与清扫合约规模，并从攻防双视角提出缓解。
evidence_note: 以太坊主网十个月真实交易的大规模在野测量，给出恶意委托、攻击交易与合约的量化规模及首个 EERA 数据集；检测框架的精度/召回数字摘要未报告。
novelty_note: 针对协议演化刚催生的 EIP-7702 委托滥用给出首个形式化攻击模型、首个在野数据集与检测框架，属新威胁模型的系统化开拓。
scope: 结论适用于支持 EIP-7702 的 EVM 兼容链上的 EOA 委托滥用；分析窗口为上线后头十个月的以太坊主网。
limitations: 依赖链上可见交易，链下合谋或混合手段可能被低估；SweeperHunter 的漏报率未在摘要给出；对钱包端防护方案的评估停留在建议层面。

title: Evaluating Structural and SAT Attack Resilience in Cryptographic Dynamic Logic Locking via Keystream Capping
abstract: Untrusted third-party entities throughout the semiconductor supply chain expose proprietary hardware intellectual property to reverse engineering, piracy, and overproduction. While logic locking counters this threat by embedding key-dependent logic, conventional static key-gates remain vulnerable to both oracle-guided SAT attacks and structural removal attacks due to their time-invariant netlist signatures. Dynamic schemes such as STREAMLOCK mitigate oracle attacks by continuously masking signals with cryptographic keystream, achieving near 50\% Hamming distance output corruption under incorrect keys with low hardware overhead. However, confining key-gates to primary outputs leaves internal combinational cones vulnerable to single-tap structural bypasses. This work extends dynamic logic locking by distributing key-gates within internal paths prioritized via fault-propagation analysis. The original and internally-hardened architectures are evaluated against structural removal attacks and a bounded, unrolling-based SAT-style attack across three ISCAS'85 benchmarks. Distributing masking internally raises the uninformed attacker's brute-force search space from 6 candidate node subsets to over $10^{45}$ for the largest benchmark. Crucially, empirical analysis reveals that topological relocation alone does not prevent algebraic key extraction when wide circuits expose numerous keystream bits per clock cycle. To eliminate this leak, a keystream-bit reuse cap is introduced to restrict per-cycle exposure independent of circuit width. Under this constraint, SAT-solver tractability encounters an immediate computational cliff, transitioning sharply from rapid under-constrained solving to timeout thresholds without disclosing the secret key. Integrating fault-aware internal placement with keystream reuse capping delivers joint resilience against structural bypasses and bounded SAT attacks.
title_cn: 基于密钥流封顶评估密码学动态逻辑锁定的结构与 SAT 攻击韧性
abstract_cn: 半导体供应链中不受信的第三方使专有硬件知识产权暴露于逆向工程、盗版与过量生产。逻辑锁定通过嵌入密钥相关逻辑对抗这一威胁，但常规静态密钥门因其时不变的网表签名而同时易受 oracle 引导的 SAT 攻击与结构性移除攻击。STREAMLOCK 等动态方案通过密码学密钥流持续掩蔽信号来缓解 oracle 攻击，在错误密钥下达到近 50% 汉明距离的输出破坏且硬件开销低；但把密钥门限定在主输出会使内部组合锥暴露于单抽头结构性绕过。本工作通过按故障传播分析优先级在内部路径分布密钥门来扩展动态逻辑锁定。原始与内部加固架构在三个 ISCAS'85 基准上对抗结构性移除攻击与有界展开式 SAT 风格攻击评估。把掩蔽内部分布使无信息攻击者的暴力搜索空间从 6 个候选节点子集提升到最大基准下的 10^45 以上。关键的实证分析揭示：当宽电路每时钟周期暴露大量密钥流位时，仅靠拓扑重定位无法阻止代数密钥提取。为消除该泄露，引入密钥流位复用上限，独立于电路宽度限制每周期暴露。在该约束下，SAT 求解器的可解性立即遭遇计算悬崖，从快速欠约束求解急剧转变为超时阈值而不泄露密钥。故障感知的内部布置与密钥流复用封顶相结合，可对结构性绕过与有界 SAT 攻击提供联合韧性。
summary_cn: 扩展动态逻辑锁定：按故障传播把密钥门分布到内部路径（搜索空间 6 子集→10^45），并提出密钥流位复用封顶堵住宽电路的代数密钥提取，SAT 求解从快速求解骤转为超时。
objective_summary: 在动态逻辑锁定中按故障传播分析内部分布密钥门，实证定位宽电路的密钥流泄露，并提出每周期密钥流位复用上限，在 ISCAS'85 基准上评估对结构移除与有界 SAT 攻击的韧性。
evidence_note: 三个 ISCAS'85 基准、两类攻击（结构移除 + 有界 SAT）对照评估，量化搜索空间与超时悬崖；基准集小、攻击为有界设定，无统计检验与会议信息。
novelty_note: 在 STREAMLOCK 之上定位并堵住「宽电路密钥流暴露」这一具体泄露，密钥流复用封顶是针对性新机制；整体属既有动态锁定路线的实质扩展。
scope: 结论适用于密钥流掩蔽型动态逻辑锁定在 ISCAS'85 规模组合电路上的表现；更先进 SAT 变体与更大网表未评估。
limitations: 仅三个基准电路；SAT 攻击为有界展开设定，未覆盖最强已知攻击；硬件开销的量化在摘要未给出。

title: LanG 2.0: Energy-Efficient Agentic AI for Semi-Automated Security Operations at Scale
abstract: Security operations centers (SOCs) need to turn terabytes of alerts, logs and flows into trusted, affordable decisions to unveil hidden threats. We present LanG 2.0, an agentic system that detects threats, correlates evidence and writes rules, investigating whether small local models can replace frontier models affordably and safely when structural safeguards, not model accuracy, provide the guarantees. It incorporates entity-anchored correlation, human approval of rule changes and a tamper-evident ledger. Tests span eight flow datasets from five networks, real XDR alerts and multistage campaigns. Against its predecessor, campaign correlation precision rises from 18.75% to 51.81%, and rule acceptance from at most 60.00% to 98.33%. Against Claude Opus 5.5, scoring flows against each network's normal traffic detects attacks on unseen networks at 73.42% F1 without false positives, versus 58.10% with 49.00% false positives, for at least 650 times less energy. Finetuned models statistically match it on alert classification and rule writing for 5.6 to 59 times less energy. The work demonstrates LanG's practical scalability, processing 3.33 million records in 6.4 minutes, over 30 million hourly, and its safeguards resisted prompt injection, label poisoning and ledger tampering, so small local models can carry most SOC detection affordably and safely.
title_cn: LanG 2.0：面向大规模半自动化安全运营的节能智能体 AI
abstract_cn: 安全运营中心（SOC）需要把数 TB 的告警、日志与流量变成可信且可负担的决策以发现隐藏威胁。我们提出 LanG 2.0，一个检测威胁、关联证据并编写规则的智能体系统，研究当结构性保障而非模型准确率提供保证时，小型本地模型能否以可负担且安全的方式替代前沿模型。系统集成实体锚定关联、规则变更的人工审批与防篡改账本。测试覆盖来自五个网络的八个流量数据集、真实 XDR 告警与多阶段攻击战役。与前代相比，战役关联精确率从 18.75% 升至 51.81%，规则采纳率从至多 60.00% 升至 98.33%。对比 Claude Opus 5.5：按各网络正常流量评分的方式在未见网络上以 73.42% F1、零误报检出攻击，而 Claude 为 58.10% F1、误报 49.00%，能耗至少低 650 倍；微调模型在告警分类与规则编写上统计相当，能耗低 5.6–59 倍。系统实测 6.4 分钟处理 333 万条记录、每小时超 3,000 万条，其保障经受住了提示注入、标签投毒与账本篡改，表明小型本地模型可以以可负担且安全的方式承担大部分 SOC 检测。
summary_cn: 智能体 SOC 系统 LanG 2.0：八个流量数据集上战役关联精确率 18.75%→51.81%，对比 Claude Opus 5.5 以 73.42% F1 零误报、能耗低至少 650 倍，6.4 分钟处理 333 万条记录。
objective_summary: 构建以实体锚定关联、人工审批与防篡改账本为保障的智能体 SOC 系统 LanG 2.0，在多网络流量与真实 XDR 告警上与前后代及前沿模型比较检测、规则质量与能耗。
evidence_note: 五个网络八个流量数据集 + 真实 XDR 告警 + 多阶段战役，与前沿模型（Claude Opus 5.5）及前代系统对照，报告 F1、误报与能耗倍数及吞吐数字；无会议信息。
novelty_note: 「小本地模型 + 结构性保障替代前沿模型」的 SOC 路线与量化能耗对比有应用新意；实体锚定关联与账本等组件为已有技术的系统集成。
scope: 结论适用于流量检测与规则编写类 SOC 任务；对告警研判之外的分析环节与跨组织泛化未评估。
limitations: 以流量数据集与模拟战役为主，真实 SOC 长期运行效果未验证；统计相当性检验的具体范围有限；对自适应攻击者的对抗评估限于三类篡改。

title: Accept Changes, Reject Attacks: Robust Memory Management for LLM Agents
abstract: Since large language model (LLM) agents rely on long-term memory, what they store now shapes what they do later. A memory manager decides how each input changes this memory and which records the agent acts on. It can fail in two ways: keeping a fact that has since changed (outdated memory), or storing a planted passage or injected instruction (memory poisoning). Most prior work studies them separately, yet they call for opposite write decisions, so no fixed write rule handles both. We therefore formalize memory robustness as handling both without doing worse on other inputs. Since accuracy checks only the answer, we measure robustness with evidence-conditioned accuracy (ECA), which also checks that the records the manager selects include all the evidence the answer needs, updated and free of attacks. However, existing memory systems and defenses are not more robust than an untuned manager on our test sets. We improve robustness with a simple one-shot recipe that fine-tunes the manager on episodes synthesized around a single conversation with inserted changes and attacks. On three backbones, it improves every category score on our test sets and more than doubles the untuned manager's overall ECA, though robustness remains incomplete.
title_cn: 接受变更、拒绝攻击：LLM 智能体的鲁棒记忆管理
abstract_cn: 由于大语言模型（LLM）智能体依赖长期记忆，现在存入什么决定之后做什么。记忆管理器决定每个输入如何改变记忆、以及智能体依据哪些记录行动。它可能以两种方式失败：保留已经变化的事实（过时记忆），或存入植入的段落与注入的指令（记忆投毒）。多数先前工作分开研究两者，但它们要求相反的写入决策，因此没有固定写入规则能同时处理。我们因此把记忆鲁棒性形式化为在不损害其他输入的前提下同时处理两者。由于准确率只检查答案，我们用证据条件准确率（ECA）度量鲁棒性：还检查管理器选出的记录包含答案所需的全部证据，且已更新、无攻击。然而在我们的测试集上，现有记忆系统与防御并不比未调优的管理器更鲁棒。我们用一个简单的一次性配方改进鲁棒性：围绕单段对话合成插入变更与攻击的片段来微调管理器。在三个骨干上，它提升测试集上所有类别得分，把未调优管理器的总体 ECA 提升一倍以上，尽管鲁棒性仍不完整。
summary_cn: 把记忆鲁棒性形式化为同时应对过时记忆与记忆投毒，提出证据条件准确率 ECA 度量与一次性合成片段微调配方：三个骨干上全部类别得分提升、总体 ECA 翻倍以上。
objective_summary: 形式化智能体记忆管理中过时与投毒两类写入失败的对立性，提出证据条件准确率 ECA 度量，并用一次性合成片段微调配方训练更鲁棒的记忆管理器。
evidence_note: 自建测试集 + 三个骨干的系统评估，报告逐类别得分与总体 ECA 提升；发现现有系统不优于未调优基线；无统计检验与会议信息。
novelty_note: 首次把过时记忆与记忆投毒统一进一个写入鲁棒性问题并指出其决策对立性，ECA 度量把「证据是否齐备且干净」纳入评估，超出只看答案的既有做法。
scope: 结论适用于带长期记忆管理器的 LLM 智能体；测试集为构造场景，真实部署记忆负载下的表现未验证。
limitations: 鲁棒性提升后仍不完整；合成片段围绕单段对话构造，多样性有限；ECA 依赖证据标注的质量。

title: Communication-Efficient Private Federated Reinforcement Learning with Post-Quantum Authentication for Vehicular Networks
abstract: Federated reinforcement learning supports cooperative vehicular routing without centralizing trajectory data, but model updates may reveal private information and incur communication overhead over intermittent vehicle-to-infrastructure links, particularly when post-quantum authentication is required. We study correlated private quantization, using complementary shared randomness between paired vehicles to reduce aggregation mean squared error while preserving the marginal parameter-level local differential privacy and one-bit communication cost of independent quantization. A tunable extension mixes shared and independent randomness to bound privacy leakage given paired outputs and shared-randomness side information. For this extension, R\'enyi differential privacy accounting establishes vector-level local differential privacy for one model upload even when pairings are revealed. Under matched vector-level privacy and identical local and global parameters, the extension yields 16.5% lower analytical aggregation mean squared error than independent quantization. We evaluate cooperative routing by coupling traffic simulation with packet-level simulation of post-quantum-authenticated vehicle-to-infrastructure communication. Compared to full-precision updates, one-bit uploads reduce authenticated uplink size by 92.4% and increase mean verified updates aggregated per round from 19.6 to 26.5. Under mobility-constrained communication at a parameter-level privacy budget of 1, correlated private quantization reduces mean travel time by 14.3% relative to independent quantization at the same budget and communication cost. At a parameter-level privacy budget of 0.3, a vehicle-origin inference attack trained on independent simulations reaches 30% accuracy with correlated private quantization and 22% with independent quantization after 100 rounds, versus 91% without privacy and 10% for random guessing.
