title_cn: 面向车联网的高效通信私有联邦强化学习与后量子认证
abstract_cn: 联邦强化学习支持协同车辆路由而不集中轨迹数据，但模型更新可能泄露隐私信息，并在间歇的车—路通信链路上带来通信开销，当要求后量子认证时尤为如此。我们研究相关私有量化：利用配对车辆间的互补共享随机性降低聚合均方误差，同时保持独立量化的参数级局部差分隐私边际与一比特通信成本。一个可调扩展混合共享与独立随机性，以在配对输出与共享随机性侧信息被给定的前提下约束隐私泄露。针对该扩展，Rényi 差分隐私核算建立了即使配对关系被揭示、单次模型上传仍满足向量级局部差分隐私。在匹配的向量级隐私与相同的本地/全局参数下，该扩展的分析聚合均方误差比独立量化低 16.5%。我们通过把交通仿真与经后量子认证的车—路通信包级仿真耦合来评估协同路由。与全精度更新相比，一比特上传把认证上行体积减少 92.4%，把每轮平均经核验聚合更新从 19.6 提升到 26.5。在移动性受限通信、参数级隐私预算为 1 时，相关私有量化把平均行程时间相对同等预算与通信成本的独立量化降低 14.3%。在隐私预算 0.3 时，训练于独立仿真的车辆来源推断攻击经 100 轮后，对相关私有量化的准确率为 30%、独立量化为 22%，无隐私时为 91%，随机猜测为 10%。
summary_cn: 利用配对车辆共享随机性的相关私有量化：聚合 MSE 比独立量化低 16.5%、一比特上传省 92.4% 认证上行、行程时间降 14.3%，隐私预算 0.3 时推断攻击准确率 30% 对无隐私 91%。
objective_summary: 提出利用配对共享随机性的相关私有量化机制，建立向量级局部差分隐私的 Rényi 核算，并在交通 + 包级联合仿真中量化通信、路由效率与推断攻击准确率。
evidence_note: Rényi DP 形式化核算 + 交通/通信双仿真多设置对照（预算 1 与 0.3、移动性受限等），量化到具体百分比，46 页 12 表，代码公开；无会议信息。
novelty_note: 在既有量化 LDP 框架上引入互补共享随机性并给出配对泄露下的 Rényi 分析，属实质性的机制改进而非新范式；车联网 + 后量子认证的系统集成有应用价值。
scope: 结论适用于存在车辆配对与共享随机性信道的联邦强化学习路由场景；隐私核算针对向量级 LDP，不涉及集中式 DP。
limitations: 全部为仿真评估，无实车实验；配对机制要求车辆间建立共享随机性，其建立协议的开销未充分讨论；推断攻击评估基于训练于独立仿真的攻击器。

title: Closing the Applied Cybersecurity Gap in Critical Infrastructure: A Cyber-to-Physical Security Assessment Framework for Water Systems
abstract: The integration of information technology and operational technology in water infrastructure creates pathways through which cyber compromise may affect physical service delivery. This study revisits the Applied Cybersecurity Gap (ACG) framework by evaluating an experimental Applied Cybersecurity Gap Index (ACGI) alongside the Cyber-to-Physical Propagation Rate (CPPR), defined as the proportion of initially compromised trials that produce a specified physical-impact outcome. The expanded evaluation comprises 2,160 synthetic trials across three water-network benchmarks, including EPANET Example Network 3 (Net3), and couples declared cyber-attack progression rules with hydraulic simulations. A source-trained machine-learning model evaluated on 247 compromised Net3 trials achieved ROC-AUC 0.772, PR-AUC 0.775, and F1 0.733, compared with 0.661, 0.642, and 0.704 for a scenario-only baseline. The configuration-cluster bootstrap interval for the ROC-AUC difference was 0.038--0.183. A separate 720-run Net3 hydraulic operating-point sensitivity analysis achieved the study's exploratory baseline pressure criterion in all reruns, preserved 717 of 720 physical-impact labels, and produced ROC-AUC 0.791 with the frozen source-trained model. Additional analyses examine the sensitivity of CPPR to the physical-impact threshold and assumed control-blocking probabilities, and demonstrate that the ACGI--CPPR association is partly induced by the simulation design rather than independently validated. The findings establish a reproducible simulation-based assessment workflow, but do not constitute field calibration of cybersecurity-control effectiveness or prediction of real-world utility incidents.
title_cn: 弥合关键信息基础设施的应用网络安全缺口：水务系统的网络—物理安全评估框架
abstract_cn: 水务基础设施中信息技术与运营技术的融合，创造了网络入侵可能影响物理服务的通路。本研究通过在三个水务网络基准（含 EPANET Example Network 3，Net3）上共 2,160 次合成试验的扩展评估，重新审视应用网络安全缺口（ACG）框架：评估实验性的应用网络安全缺口指数（ACGI）与网络—物理传播率（CPPR，初始被攻陷试验中产生特定物理影响结局的比例），并将声明的网络攻击推进规则与水力仿真耦合。一个以数据源训练的机器学习模型在 247 次被攻陷的 Net3 试验上取得 ROC-AUC 0.772、PR-AUC 0.775 与 F1 0.733，而仅场景基线为 0.661、0.642 与 0.704；ROC-AUC 差值的配置聚类自助区间为 0.038–0.183。另一项 720 次运行的 Net3 水力操作点敏感性分析在所有重跑中达到研究设定的探索性基线压力判据、保留 720 个物理影响标签中的 717 个，并用冻结的源训练模型取得 ROC-AUC 0.791。额外分析检验 CPPR 对物理影响阈值与假定控制阻断概率的敏感性，并证明 ACGI–CPPR 关联部分由仿真设计诱导而非经独立验证。研究发现建立了可复现的基于仿真的评估工作流，但不构成网络安全控制有效性的现场校准，也不能预测真实世界公用事业事故。
summary_cn: 以三个水务网络基准 2,160 次合成试验评估 ACGI 指数与网络—物理传播率 CPPR：ML 模型 ROC-AUC 0.772 对基线 0.661（自助区间 0.038–0.183），并坦陈 ACGI–CPPR 关联部分由仿真设计诱导。
objective_summary: 构建耦合攻击推进规则与水力仿真的网络—物理评估工作流，量化 ACGI 指数与 CPPR 指标的关系及 ML 预测性能，并系统分析仿真设计的敏感性。
evidence_note: 2,160 次合成试验、三网络基准、720 次敏感性重跑，报告 ROC-AUC/PR-AUC/F1 与自助置信区间；但全部为仿真数据，作者自陈无现场校准。
novelty_note: 把 ACG 框架扩展到网络—物理传播、提出 CPPR 度量并诚实指出指数关联的仿真诱导成分，对水务工控风险评估有方法价值；框架本体为既有概念的延伸。
scope: 结论适用于仿真环境中的水务系统风险评估工作流；不构成真实水务设施的控制有效性校准或事故预测。
limitations: 全部基于合成试验与声明的攻击推进规则；ACGI–CPPR 关联部分由仿真设计诱导；物理影响阈值与控制阻断概率假设敏感。

title: Characterizing Recoverable Expert-Utilization Signatures in Fine-Tuned Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
abstract: As Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models are increasingly deployed in distributed environments, from federated learning to edge-cloud systems, their architecture harbors an underexplored landscape of security vulnerabilities. Moving beyond textual analysis, we uncover structural memorization: a novel vulnerability where a fine-tuned model memorizes not only its training data but also the internal pathway used to process it, creating a characteristic routing fingerprint unique to the training process. We provide comprehensive empirical evidence that structural memorization emerges consistently even from a few samples, and that its intensity is directly influenced by the choice of trainable modules. We show that these memorized expert pathways can be stealthily recovered through the model's unconditional generation, using only routing and output logits, with no knowledge of the fine-tuning data or procedure. In distributed deployments, this vulnerability is amplified as routing information is exposed at multiple trust boundaries, including federated aggregation points, edge-cloud interfaces, and multi-tenant monitoring systems. Recovery exposes a critical blind spot: traditional membership inference metrics, viewed through the lens of expert routing, fail to identify memorized data corresponding to these structural pathways. To close this gap, we devise composite metrics combining reference model tail likelihood with complexity-aware normalization, significantly improving detection of memorized routing structures. This enables adversaries to pinpoint critical experts shaped by fine-tuning, whether dominant or dormant, and execute targeted attacks such as router manipulation or backdoor injection in realistic distributed settings where attackers lack training data but can observe routing patterns across system components.
title_cn: 刻画微调混合专家 LLM 中可恢复的专家利用签名
abstract_cn: 随着混合专家（MoE）大语言模型越来越多地部署于联邦学习到边缘—云系统等分布式环境，其架构中潜藏一片未被充分探索的安全脆弱地带。我们超越文本分析，揭示结构性记忆：微调模型不仅记忆训练数据，还会记忆处理它时所用的内部通路，形成训练过程特有的路由指纹。我们提供全面的实证证据表明结构性记忆即使从少量样本也会稳定出现，其强度直接受可训练模块选择的影响。我们证明这些被记忆的专家通路可以通过模型的无条件生成被隐秘恢复，仅用路由与输出 logits、无需知道微调数据或过程。在分布式部署中，路由信息在联邦聚合点、边缘—云接口与多租户监控系统等多个信任边界暴露，使该漏洞被放大。恢复暴露出一个关键盲区：从专家路由的视角看，传统成员推断指标无法识别与这些结构性通路对应的被记忆数据。为弥补这一缺口，我们设计结合参考模型尾部似然与复杂度感知归一化的复合指标，显著提升对被记忆路由结构的检测。这使对手能够定位被微调塑造的关键专家（无论主导还是休眠），并在攻击者没有训练数据但能跨系统组件观察路由模式的现实分布式环境中执行路由操纵或后门注入等定向攻击。
summary_cn: 揭示 MoE 微调模型的「结构性记忆」：仅凭路由与输出 logits 即可经无条件生成恢复被记忆的专家通路，传统成员推断指标失效；提出复合检测指标并演示路由操纵/后门注入风险。
objective_summary: 发现微调 MoE 模型会记忆专家路由通路并可通过无条件生成恢复，量化其发生条件与可训练模块的关系，提出检测被记忆路由结构的复合指标。
evidence_note: 自称全面实证：少量样本即可出现、受可训练模块选择影响、多信任边界放大；检测指标有量化改进；摘要未列具体数据集与数字，无统计检验与会议信息。
novelty_note: 把记忆研究从文本层推进到 MoE 内部路由通路层，指出传统成员推断对该通道失效，是新的攻击面与检测缺口。
scope: 结论适用于微调过的 MoE 架构模型及路由信息可被观察的分布式部署；对稠密模型与非 MoE 架构不适用。
limitations: 实验规模与模型集合摘要未说明；检测指标依赖参考模型；对攻击者能观察路由的威胁模型假设较强。

title: An Incentive-Aligned Trust-Centric Coordination Layer for Heterogeneous Blockchain Interoperability
abstract: The interoperability between permissioned and public blockchains is hampered by asymmetric privacy, trust, and governance assumptions. We propose a coordination architecture that decouples cross-domain trust management and privacy enforcement from underlying blockchain protocols, requiring no protocol-level modifications. The framework integrates cryptographic unlinkability mechanisms with incentive-compatible relay selection, combining stake-weighted participation and temporally accumulated reputation to align economic commitment with sustained correctness. We formalize the adversarial model and derive security and privacy properties for cross-domain coordination, demonstrating robustness against Sybil infiltration, collusion, and strategic stake concentration. Simulation-based analysis characterizes key design trade-offs between quorum thresholds, reputation memory, and anonymity parameters, indicating that privacy-preserving coordination can be achieved without degrading responsiveness or incentive stability when parameters are properly tuned.
title_cn: 面向异构区块链互操作性的激励对齐、以信任为中心的协调层
abstract_cn: 许可链与公链之间的互操作性受制于不对称的隐私、信任与治理假设。我们提出一种协调架构，把跨域信任管理与隐私强制从底层区块链协议中解耦，无需协议级修改。该框架把密码学不可链接机制与激励兼容的中继选择相结合，以权益加权参与和随时间累积的声誉使经济承诺与持续的正确行为对齐。我们形式化对抗模型并推导跨域协调的安全与隐私性质，论证其对女巫渗透、合谋与策略性权益集中的鲁棒性。基于仿真的分析刻画了法定人数阈值、声誉记忆与匿名性参数之间的关键设计权衡，表明当参数恰当设置时，隐私保护协调可以在不牺牲响应性或激励稳定性的情况下实现。
summary_cn: 提出把跨域信任与隐私强制从链协议解耦的协调层，结合不可链接机制与权益加权 + 声誉累积的中继选择，形式化推导抗女巫/合谋性质并仿真权衡参数。
objective_summary: 设计解耦信任管理与隐私强制的异构链互操作协调架构，形式化对抗模型、推导安全与隐私性质，并以仿真刻画法定人数、声誉与匿名参数的权衡。
evidence_note: 安全与隐私性质为形式化推导，行为层面结论来自仿真参数分析，无实现、无真实部署数据，理论 + 初步实验。
novelty_note: 把不可链接机制与激励兼容中继选择组合进统一跨域协调层是较新的架构组合；个别组件（声誉累积、权益加权）均为已有技术。
scope: 结论适用于许可链—公链跨域协调的架构设计与参数选择层面；未在真实跨链部署中验证。
limitations: 仿真假设可能不覆盖真实网络动态与对手策略空间；声誉机制自身的抗操纵性依赖模型假设；无原型实现与性能测量。

title: Adaptive Dynamic Security for Operational Technology Against AI-Powered Attacks
abstract: Operational technology now faces attackers whose tempo is set by AI. We present ADS-OT, an adaptive dynamic security framework modelling defensive posture as a partially observable decision problem. A reinforcement-learning policy adapts monitoring, access, deception, and segmentation under a safety-governance layer, reducing attack-path completion, detection, and containment versus static baselines.
title_cn: 面向运营技术的自适应动态安全：应对 AI 驱动的攻击
abstract_cn: 运营技术（OT）如今面对由 AI 定节奏的攻击者。我们提出 ADS-OT，一个自适应动态安全框架，把防御态势建模为部分可观测决策问题。强化学习策略在安全治理层的约束下自适应调整监控、访问、欺骗与分段，相比静态基线降低攻击路径完成率、提升检测与遏制能力。
summary_cn: 把 OT 防御态势建模为部分可观测决策问题，用强化学习在安全治理层下动态调整监控、访问、欺骗与分段，自称较静态基线降低攻击路径完成率并改善检测与遏制。
objective_summary: 提出把监控、访问、欺骗与分段组合为强化学习策略输出的 OT 自适应动态安全框架 ADS-OT，并声明与静态基线比较攻防指标。
evidence_note: 摘要未给出任何定量结果、实验环境或对比数字，框架描述层面的原型可行性，9 页短文。
novelty_note: 把动态防御（移动目标 + 欺骗）以 RL 统一编排并应用于 OT 场景、以 AI 攻击节奏为动机，属已有技术的场景组合；治理层约束的引入有一定设计新意。
scope: 概念与框架层面适用于 OT/ICS 环境的防御编排；具体有效性取决于未公开细节的实验设置。
limitations: 摘要与正文均未报告定量结果与实验细节；RL 策略在安全关键 OT 环境的可验证性未讨论；未给出真实系统部署。

title: Towards Elastic Least Privilege for Agent Planning
abstract: General-purpose AI agents require authority that changes between tasks and during execution. Common deployments trade broad permissions that expose unnecessary authority and narrow permissions that raise approval requests. Existing mechanisms can enforce dynamic authority, but agent tool interfaces rarely provide the agent's planner, the component that chooses its actions, a means of comparing the authority required by alternative actions or of seeing the cost of the authority it already holds. Drawing on the rich history of access control research, we propose the concept of \emph{elastic least privilege}, in which an agent begins with a small baseline of authority and may acquire more within an owner-defined envelope. Elevations are leased and measured against a replenishing budget. Their cost increases with power, proximity to mandatory safety invariants, and repeated requests. Costs are visible to the planner, which can prefer lower-privilege choices and release authority it no longer needs. Authority returns automatically to the baseline when a lease expires, when it is released, or when the budget is exhausted, while persistent legitimate demand may prompt an owner-approved change to the baseline. Building on prior risk-priced and budget-aware access control, we redesign these mechanisms for agents. How best to implement the approach and how well it works in practice are open research questions. In this paper, we present how the approach could work, illustrate the model, and set an open research agenda.
title_cn: 面向智能体规划的弹性最小权限
abstract_cn: 通用 AI 智能体需要的权限在任务之间与执行过程中不断变化。常见部署要么授予暴露不必要权限的宽泛权限，要么采用抬升审批请求量的狭窄权限。现有机制可以强制动态权限，但智能体工具接口很少为智能体的规划器——选择行动的组件——提供比较不同行动所需权限、或看清已有权限代价的手段。借鉴访问控制研究的丰富历史，我们提出弹性最小权限（elastic least privilege）概念：智能体从较小的基线权限出发，可在所有者定义的包络内获取更多权限。提权以租约形式发放，并按可补充的预算计量；代价随权力大小、与强制安全不变量的接近程度以及重复请求次数增加。代价对规划器可见，规划器可偏好低权限选择并释放不再需要的权限。当租约到期、被释放或预算耗尽时，权限自动回到基线；持续正当的需求可触发所有者批准的基线变更。基于既有的风险定价与预算感知访问控制，我们为智能体重新设计这些机制。如何实现该方案、以及它在实践中的效果如何，都是开放研究问题。本文给出该方案可能的形态、用示例说明模型，并设定一个开放研究议程。
summary_cn: 提出「弹性最小权限」概念：智能体从小基线出发在所有者包络内租约式提权、按递增代价计量并对规划器可见，到期自动回落，为智能体动态授权设定研究议程。
objective_summary: 借鉴风险定价与预算感知访问控制，提出面向智能体规划的弹性最小权限模型：租约化提权、递增代价、规划器可见与自动回落，并给出示例与开放研究议程。
evidence_note: 纯概念与模型刻画，论文自陈实现方式与实际效果均为开放问题，无经验验证。
novelty_note: 把风险定价、预算感知等访问控制概念系统改造并组合为面向智能体规划的权限模型，提出明确的新概念名与设计空间；组件源头均为已有工作。
scope: 适用范围为通用智能体的权限管理设计空间；不含任何实现、评测或部署结论。
limitations: 无实现与实证评估；代价函数与包络设定依赖人工；与现有智能体框架的兼容性未讨论。

title: Does Showing Agents the Privilege of Their Tools Reduce Over-Privileged Tool Selection?
abstract: When several tools can complete a task, an agent that picks the most powerful one holds more authority than the task needs. Recent work demonstrates that language-model agents do this often, and more so after a tool fails. Approaches to restrict focus so far on either enforcing least privilege outside the model or retraining the model. We ask a simpler question: does it help to tell the agent what each tool's privilege is? To investigate this question, we run all 544 ToolPrivBench scenarios on eight models, three run locally, and five through a hosted API, under five conditions: (1) no signal, (2) a least-privilege instruction, (3) privilege class and cost shown in each tool description, (4) both the instruction and privilege information, and (5) a matched neutral-metadata control. Showing privilege lowers premature escalation on every model that over-privileges at a measurable rate, reducing over-privileged selection by up to 19.3 percentage points (50\%), whereas irrelevant metadata in the same format does not. On most models, however, information alone mainly delays escalation until the standard tools have been tried. Combined with the instruction it more often avoids escalation, and the share of scenarios completed without a risk tool rises on seven of the eight models, reaching 51.1\% safe completion from a baseline of 18.8\% on the strongest-performing configuration. Visible privilege is therefore a cheap complement to enforcement rather than a substitute.
title_cn: 让智能体看见工具的权限，能减少过度授权的工具选择吗？
abstract_cn: 当多个工具都能完成任务时，选择最强大工具的智能体握有超出任务所需的权限。近期工作表明语言模型智能体经常这样做，且在工具失败后更甚。现有限制手段聚焦于在模型之外强制最小权限或重新训练模型。我们问一个更简单的问题：告诉智能体每个工具的权限是什么，有没有帮助？为研究这一问题，我们在八个模型（三个本地、五个托管 API）上、在五种条件下运行 ToolPrivBench 全部 544 个场景：(1) 无信号；(2) 最小权限指令；(3) 在每个工具描述中展示权限类别与代价；(4) 指令与权限信息兼有；(5) 匹配的中性元数据对照。展示权限降低了每个以可测频率过度授权的模型的过早升级，把过度授权选择最多降低 19.3 个百分点（50%），而同格式的无关元数据无此效果。但在多数模型上，仅提供信息主要是把升级推迟到标准工具被尝试之后；与指令结合则更常避免升级，八个模型中有七个「不经过风险工具完成场景」的占比上升，最佳配置从 18.8% 基线达到 51.1% 的安全完成率。可见权限因此是强制手段的廉价补充，而非替代。
summary_cn: 在 ToolPrivBench 544 场景 × 8 模型 × 5 条件的受控实验中，向智能体展示工具权限把过度授权选择最多降 19.3 个百分点（50%），配合指令后最佳配置安全完成率从 18.8% 升至 51.1%。
objective_summary: 通过五种条件（无信号/指令/权限信息/兼有/中性对照）在 544 个场景与八个模型上量化「权限可见性」对智能体过度授权工具选择的影响。
evidence_note: 544 场景 × 8 模型 × 5 条件的受控设计，含匹配中性元数据对照，量化到百分点并区分「延迟升级」与「避免升级」；无统计检验与会议信息。
novelty_note: 问题驱动的实证研究：把「让权限可见」从直觉变成有对照的量化结论，并揭示信息主要延迟而非消除升级；建立在既有 ToolPrivBench 之上。
scope: 结论适用于 ToolPrivBench 覆盖的工具选择场景与所测八个模型；对更复杂的多轮任务与真实生产智能体的迁移未验证。
limitations: 单一基准场景；仅测量单轮工具选择行为；权限信息描述的措辞效应未消融。

title: LiHA: Worse is Better for Lightweight Hash-based Source Authentication
abstract: The omission of source IP authentication remains a fundamental vulnerability in the Internet. Existing approaches rely on routing plausibility, topology assumptions, per-flow state, or wide deployment. These requirements have kept strong source authentication out of the data plane. As simplicity is the key to deployability, we present LiHA, a lightweight source authentication mechanism built around operations that routers already perform efficiently. LiHA binds secret keys to source prefixes using longest prefix match and authenticates each packet with a single message authentication code (MAC). The data plane requires no handshakes, per-flow state, or per-packet control plane access. A sender performs one prefix lookup and one fixed-size hash. The verifier repeats the same operations and forwards the packet only if the MAC matches. LiHA is designed for incremental deployment. It primarily protects against off-path attackers that spoof source prefixes they do not control. An on-path attacker can replay valid authenticated packets until the key rotates. LiHA does not eliminate every denial-of-service threat. Instead, it confines accepted traffic to authenticated source prefix space within participating networks. We argue that simpler source authentication with clear limits is more likely to be deployed. We implemented LiHA in three environments: as a set of user-space libraries, as eBPF programs, and in an FPGA. We found that the user-space implementation had very high overheads. The eBPF implementation got reasonable single thread performance even with a software based cryptographic hash. We found that only the FPGA could obtain 100 Gbps single thread performance, but that was only when bypassing the kernel using a DPDK user-level networking stack.
title_cn: LiHA：轻量哈希源认证的「差即是好」
abstract_cn: 源 IP 认证的缺失仍是互联网的一个根本性漏洞。现有方案依赖路由合理性、拓扑假设、每流状态或广泛部署，这些要求使强源认证始终未能进入数据平面。由于简单是可部署性的关键，我们提出 LiHA，一个围绕路由器本就高效执行的操作构建的轻量源认证机制。LiHA 用最长前缀匹配把密钥绑定到源前缀，并用单个消息认证码（MAC）认证每个数据包。数据平面不需要握手、每流状态或逐包访问控制平面。发送方执行一次前缀查找与一次定长哈希；验证方重复相同操作，仅在 MAC 匹配时转发数据包。LiHA 面向增量部署设计：它主要防御伪造自己不控制的源前缀的离径攻击者；在径攻击者可以在密钥轮换前重放有效认证包。LiHA 不消除所有拒绝服务威胁，而是把接受的流量限制在参与网络的已认证源前缀空间内。我们论证：边界清晰、更简单的源认证更可能被部署。我们在三种环境中实现 LiHA：用户态库、eBPF 程序与 FPGA。用户态实现开销极高；即便使用软件密码哈希，eBPF 实现也获得合理的单线程性能；只有 FPGA 在用 DPDK 用户态网络栈绕过内核时才能达到单线程 100 Gbps。
summary_cn: 把密钥经最长前缀匹配绑定源前缀、每包一次 MAC 的轻量源认证 LiHA：eBPF 实现性能合理，仅 FPGA + DPDK 达单线程 100 Gbps，主打以简单换可部署性。
objective_summary: 设计基于前缀绑定密钥与单 MAC 的源认证机制 LiHA，分析其防御边界（离径伪造、在径重放），并在用户态、eBPF 与 FPGA 三种环境中实现并测量性能。
evidence_note: 三种实现环境的性能测量（含 100 Gbps FPGA 数据），安全性质以论证而非形式化证明给出，明确陈述防御边界；无统计检验与会议信息。
novelty_note: 源认证是老问题，LiHA 的新意在设计立场（用路由器已有操作换取可部署性、明确放弃部分威胁）与现代实现路径（eBPF/FPGA）；机制本身是成熟组件的新组合。
scope: 结论适用于参与增量的网络内对离径前缀伪造的防护；在径重放仅由密钥轮换缓解，不覆盖完整 DoS 威胁。
limitations: 无法防御在径攻击者的重放（至多到密钥轮换）；需要参与网络协作才有保护范围；安全性论证非形式化。

title: Coupled or Independent? Fault Coupling in Agentic Medical Vision Systems
abstract: Vision-language agents equipped with tools expose intermediate outputs for inspection and comparison with the model's reasoning, which may offer safety benefits over single-shot models. This paper tests that potential benefit when the sensor reading itself is untrusted, so that the tool and reasoning channels share a common visual fault. We consider a dermatology agent based on segmentation, contrastive retrieval, and an iterative vision-language reasoner and define a coupling taxonomy that distinguishes single-channel errors from joint errors that agree or disagree. On PAD-UFES-20, we show that typographic injection produces detectable directional retrieval capture, whereas physical corruption does not. Crop-first retrieval preserves the payload at a readable scale and produces 55% joint wrong agreement across all cases (71% of faulty cases); full-image retrieval produces 35% (43%). Under a binary decision, if both channels are wrong, their predictions must agree, so hard-label channel comparison cannot detect joint failures, limiting disagreement recall to 0.29 (crop-first) versus 0.57 (full-image). The direction of the order effect is reproduced on the independent HIBA test set.
title_cn: 耦合还是独立？医疗视觉智能体系统中的故障耦合
abstract_cn: 配备工具的视觉—语言智能体会暴露中间输出供检查、并与模型推理比对，这可能比单次推理模型更安全。本文检验当传感器读数本身不可信、工具与推理通道共享同一视觉故障时，这一潜在收益是否成立。我们考虑一个由分割、对比检索与迭代视觉—语言推理器构成的皮肤病学智能体，并定义区分单通道错误与一致/不一致联合错误的耦合分类法。在 PAD-UFES-20 上，我们发现排版注入产生可检测的定向检索捕获，而物理损坏则不然；裁剪优先的检索以可读尺度保留载荷，在全部病例中产生 55% 的联合错误一致（故障病例中 71%），全图检索为 35%（43%）。在二分类决策下，若两个通道皆错其预测必然一致，因此硬标签通道比对无法检测联合故障，不一致召回率限于 0.29（裁剪优先）对 0.57（全图）。该顺序效应的方向在独立的 HIBA 测试集上得到复现。
summary_cn: 在皮肤病学视觉智能体上定义故障耦合分类法：工具与推理通道共享视觉故障时，裁剪优先检索使 55% 病例出现联合错误一致，硬标签通道比对的不一致召回率只有 0.29–0.57。
objective_summary: 以皮肤病学分割—检索—推理智能体为对象定义单通道/联合故障耦合分类法，量化排版注入与物理损坏下两通道联合错误率及硬标签比对的检测极限。
evidence_note: PAD-UFES-20 与独立 HIBA 测试集双数据集、注入/损坏两类故障对照、量化联合一致率与不一致召回；9 页 5 表，无统计检验与会议信息。
novelty_note: 指出「工具与推理通道共享同一传感器故障」这一被忽视的耦合情形，并证明通道比对类安全机制在硬标签下结构性失效，具诊断价值；所用组件均为已有技术。
scope: 结论适用于以视觉输入为共同来源、含检索与迭代推理的医疗视觉智能体；限于皮肤病学两个数据集与排版注入/物理损坏两类故障。
limitations: 仅覆盖皮肤科任务与二分类决策场景；注入仅考虑排版类；软标签比对等替代检测机制未系统评估。

title: "Shall We Approve?" Consequence-Aware Approval for Autonomous Coding Agents
abstract: Coding agents increasingly rely on automated approvers to decide whether a proposed shell command may run. Existing approvers, from rule-based checkers to guardrail models and deployed permission classifiers, base their decisions on the text of the request and command. Yet a command's behavior depends on the code it invokes and the state of the workspace, and systems that observe file changes leave the assessment to the agent or a human after execution. We present Caper, a consequence-aware approval mechanism that pre-executes each command in a snapshotted sandbox, provides an independent approver with a bounded report of its observed effects, commits allowed commands, and rolls back blocked ones with a reason the agent can act on. Compared with six existing systems, Caper achieves the lowest harmful-outcome rate on SABER (6.7% versus at least 14.8%) and YoloFS-Ext, a benchmark we build in which harmful behavior is hidden inside invoked tools (7.8% versus at least 35.3%), while blocking 1.0% of the safe twins of the dangerous tasks in YoloFS-Ext.
title_cn: 「要批准吗？」：面向自主编码智能体的后果感知审批
abstract_cn: 编码智能体日益依赖自动审批器来决定一条拟执行的 shell 命令是否可以运行。现有审批器——从基于规则的检查器、护栏模型到已部署的权限分类器——都基于请求与命令的文本做判断。然而命令的行为取决于它调用的代码与工作区状态，而观察文件改动的系统又把评估留给执行后的智能体或人类。我们提出 Caper，一种后果感知的审批机制：在快照沙箱中预执行每条命令，向独立审批器提供其观察效果的有界报告，提交被允许的命令，并以智能体可据以行动的理由回滚被阻止的命令。与六个现有系统相比，Caper 在 SABER 上取得最低的有害结果率（6.7% 对至少 14.8%），在我们构建的、把有害行为藏在被调用工具内的 YoloFS-Ext 基准上亦然（7.8% 对至少 35.3%），同时对 YoloFS-Ext 中危险任务的安全孪生只阻断 1.0%。
summary_cn: 沙箱预执行 + 后果报告 + 可回滚的审批机制 Caper：SABER 有害结果率 6.7%（对比系统至少 14.8%），自建 YoloFS-Ext 上 7.8%（对比至少 35.3%），安全孪生误阻仅 1.0%。
objective_summary: 提出在快照沙箱中预执行命令、向独立审批器提交有界后果报告并支持带理由回滚的 Caper，与六个现有审批系统在 SABER 与自建 YoloFS-Ext 上比较有害结果率与误阻率。
evidence_note: 与六个现有系统对照、外部 SABER 基准 + 自建 YoloFS-Ext 双评测，报告有害结果率与安全孪生误阻率，24 页 9 图篇幅；未报告统计检验与会议信息。
novelty_note: 把审批依据从命令文本转为沙箱中观察到的实际后果，并配套提交/回滚闭环，是对文本审批范式的实质机制革新；自建基准也瞄准既有评测盲区（藏在被调用工具内的有害行为）。
scope: 结论适用于 shell 命令级审批场景；评估限于 SABER 与 YoloFS-Ext 两类基准任务，沙箱逃逸与超出快照范围的副作用威胁未覆盖。
limitations: 沙箱预执行带来额外时延与资源开销；预执行观察不到的后果（如后续外联）依赖有界报告的保真度；第二基准为自建。

title: Safin-1.5: Safety-Native Architecture and Verifiable Reasoning for Recursive Safety Improvement
abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) enables large language models to advance their capabilities through successive updates, but these updates can also introduce new risks and weaken existing safeguards. In line with the AI-45{\deg} Law, we pursue Safety RSI, in which safety develops as an intrinsic capability alongside general model capabilities through continual risk discovery and repair, while preserving utility and limiting over-refusal. We introduce Safin-1.5, a model built on a safety architecture and trained through recursive safety improvement, with an inference-time harness that extends its capabilities to formal reasoning. Our approach comprises three components: i) The safety architecture combines persistent safety states with hazardous-knowledge disentanglement. The former retains and selectively invokes safety knowledge, while the latter relocates targeted hazardous knowledge into removable experts, enabling its removal with minimal impact on general capabilities. ii) Recursive safety improvement establishes a discovery-evaluation-repair loop. The loop identifies new vulnerabilities and uses experimental feedback to develop repair strategies. It accepts updates only when they improve safety while preserving general capabilities and limiting over-refusal. iii) The formal reasoning harness combines the model's language understanding with symbolic inference and verification. Proof-obligation-guided semantic bridging recovers missing relations in formal representations, enabling symbolic solvers to construct checkable proofs under formalized premises and accepted semantic bridges. Experimental results demonstrate that Safin-1.5 achieves safety and reasoning performance, outperforming frontier models.
title_cn: Safin-1.5：安全原生架构与可验证推理驱动的递归安全改进
abstract_cn: 递归自我改进（RSI）使大语言模型能够通过连续更新提升能力，但这些更新也可能引入新风险、削弱既有安全护栏。顺应 AI-45 度法则，我们追求安全 RSI：让安全作为与通用能力并行的内在能力，通过持续的风险发现与修复发展，同时保持效用并限制过度拒答。我们提出 Safin-1.5，一个构建在安全架构之上、经递归安全改进训练、并配以把能力扩展到形式化推理的推理时 harness 的模型。方法包含三个组件：i) 安全架构结合持久安全状态与危险知识解缠：前者保留并按需调用安全知识，后者把目标危险知识迁移到可移除的专家模块中，使其能在几乎不影响通用能力的情况下被移除。ii) 递归安全改进建立发现—评估—修复循环：识别新漏洞，利用实验反馈制定修复策略，只有当更新在提升安全的同时保持通用能力并限制过度拒答时才被接受。iii) 形式化推理 harness 结合模型的语言理解与符号推理及验证：以证明义务引导的语义桥接恢复形式表示中缺失的关系，使符号求解器能在形式化前提与被接受的语义桥下构造可检验的证明。实验结果表明 Safin-1.5 在安全与推理上均有表现，优于前沿模型。
summary_cn: 提出安全原生的 Safin-1.5：持久安全状态 + 可移除危险知识专家、发现—评估—修复的递归安全改进循环与形式化推理 harness，自称安全与推理均优于前沿模型。
objective_summary: 提出由持久安全状态、危险知识解缠到可移除专家、递归安全改进循环与形式化推理 harness 组成的 Safin-1.5 模型体系，并在安全与推理基准上与前沿模型比较。
evidence_note: 完整训练体系并声称在安全与推理基准上优于前沿模型，29 页篇幅暗示较全面的实验；但摘要未给出具体基准数字，无统计检验与会议信息，难以独立核验。
novelty_note: 「安全随模型递归改进」的定位 + 可移除危险知识专家 + 仅接受安全增益更新的治理循环，是模型安全训练的新架构路线，而非单点防御技巧。
scope: 结论适用于该论文自建训练流程下的 Safin-1.5 模型本身；安全 RSI 的长期一致性、更大规模与开放环境行为未验证。
limitations: 关键基准数字未在摘要给出，独立复现困难；危险知识解缠依赖可辨识的「危险」范畴界定；递归改进循环的收敛性与失效率未报告。

title: CLIC: Closed-Loop Intent Consistency for Securing LLM-Driven Control in Open RAN
abstract: With the progressive capabilities of large language models (LLMs), researchers are finding ways to integrate them into the control loops of Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) to enable slicing and resource management through user intents. However, integration of LLMs in the O-RAN control loop via the RAN Intelligent Controller (RIC) makes the system vulnerable to \textit{runtime prompt injection threats}, which manipulate control decisions without violating interface authentication, and \textit{residual virtual prompt injection (VPI)} attacks that plant trigger mechanisms to silently steer the behaviour during fine-tuning. Existing studies address only the runtime threat and do not enforce consistency across the full control path, i.e. from the certified A1 intent, through the multi-step LLM trajectory, to the final E2 action. We propose a closed-loop intent-consistency layer (CLIC) that jointly mitigates both threats. The proposed CLIC defines a formal consistency score using a small quantized language model, which is deployed as a Non-RT rApp for model-integrity certification along with a Near-RT xApp for runtime enforcement. We implement CLIC on the OpenAI Cellular (OAIC) platform and evaluate it under domain-adapted JailbreakBench, AdvBench, and VPI workloads. The experimental results show that the proposed CLIC reduces the attack success rate from 0.92 to 0.29 and residual VPI attacks from 0.37 to 0.04, while improving isolation and fairness at slightly higher latency costs, i.e. approximately 27 ms.
title_cn: CLIC：面向 O-RAN 中 LLM 驱动控制安全的闭环意图一致性
abstract_cn: 随着大语言模型（LLM）能力增强，研究者正把它们接入开放无线接入网（O-RAN）的控制回路，通过用户意图实现切片与资源管理。然而经 RAN 智能控制器（RIC）把 LLM 接入 O-RAN 控制回路，使系统暴露于运行时提示注入威胁——它在不违反接口认证的情况下操纵控制决策——以及残留虚拟提示注入（VPI）攻击——它在微调时埋设触发机制、此后悄悄改变行为。现有研究只处理运行时威胁，且未在整个控制路径（从经认证的 A1 意图，经多步 LLM 轨迹，到最终 E2 动作）上强制一致性。我们提出闭环意图一致性层（CLIC）联合缓解两类威胁。CLIC 用一个小型量化语言模型定义形式化一致性分数，部署为 Non-RT rApp 做模型完整性认证、Near-RT xApp 做运行时强制。我们在 OpenAI Cellular（OAIC）平台上实现 CLIC，并在领域适配的 JailbreakBench、AdvBench 与 VPI 负载下评估。实验结果表明 CLIC 把攻击成功率从 0.92 降到 0.29，把残留 VPI 攻击从 0.37 降到 0.04，同时以约 27 ms 的稍高时延代价改善隔离与公平性。
summary_cn: 在 O-RAN 控制回路部署量化小模型一致性分数层 CLIC：OAIC 平台上把运行时提示注入成功率从 0.92 降到 0.29、残留 VPI 从 0.37 降到 0.04，时延代价约 27 ms。
objective_summary: 提出覆盖 A1 意图—LLM 轨迹—E2 动作全路径的一致性分数层 CLIC，以 rApp/xApp 双组件联合缓解运行时提示注入与微调残留 VPI，并在 OAIC 平台上量化攻防效果。
evidence_note: 在 OpenAI Cellular 平台上实现并用领域适配的 JailbreakBench、AdvBench 与 VPI 负载评估，报告 ASR 与时延数字；6 页短文，无统计检验与会议信息。
novelty_note: 首次把运行时注入与微调期残留 VPI 纳入同一闭环一致性框架并落到 O-RAN 控制路径；机制（量化小模型一致性评分）属已有组件的新场景组合。
scope: 结论适用于经 RIC 接入 LLM 的 O-RAN 切片与资源管理控制回路；评估基于 OAIC 实验平台与领域适配攻击集，未覆盖真实运营商网络。
limitations: 一致性分数依赖小型量化模型，可能被自适应攻击绕过；约 27 ms 时延对硬实时控制可能仍偏高；VPI 威胁模型假设攻击者能影响微调数据。

title: Prevented is Not Protected: What Attack Success Rate Hides about RAG
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is vulnerable to knowledge poisoning, where adversaries manipulate retrieved evidence to influence model outputs. Existing defenses are primarily evaluated using attack success rate (ASR), which obscures defense-induced failures and the mechanisms behind apparent attack prevention. To address this issue, this work introduces \textbf{Aligned RAG Evaluation}, a matched-query protocol that jointly examines clean and poisoned responses, with and without defense. By combining matched conditions analysis, LLM-judge endorsement, and retrieval dependence controls, the proposed framework distinguishes prevented from introduced failures, target mentions from LLM endorsement, and single-passage influence from evidence composition. Experiments on HotpotQA and Natural Questions reveal that existing defenses can introduce unexpected target-positive answers, although they can prevent some attacks, while evaluation criteria can also change defense rankings. Our findings expose critical blind spots in ASR-based evaluation and motivate a more comprehensive assessment of RAG poisoning defenses. The code and the evaluation artifact are available at https://github.com/chxhana/aligned-rag-eval.
title_cn: 被阻止不等于被保护：攻击成功率掩盖了 RAG 的什么
abstract_cn: 检索增强生成（RAG）易受知识投毒攻击：对手操纵被检索的证据来影响模型输出。现有防御主要用攻击成功率（ASR）评估，这一指标既掩盖防御自身引入的失败，也掩盖表面攻击被阻止背后的机制。为此，本工作提出对齐 RAG 评估（Aligned RAG Evaluation），一个联合考察干净与被投毒响应、有防御与无防御的匹配查询协议。通过结合匹配条件分析、LLM 裁判背书与检索依赖控制，该框架区分被阻止的失败与被引入的失败、目标提及与 LLM 背书、单段落影响与证据组合效应。在 HotpotQA 与 Natural Questions 上的实验揭示：现有防御虽能阻止部分攻击，却会引入意料之外的正向目标答案；且评估标准的改变也会改变防御的排名。这些发现暴露了基于 ASR 的评估的关键盲区，并推动对 RAG 投毒防御更全面的评估。代码与评估工件见 https://github.com/chxhana/aligned-rag-eval。
summary_cn: 提出匹配查询的 Aligned RAG Evaluation 协议，揭示 ASR 指标的盲区：HotpotQA 与 NQ 上现有 RAG 投毒防御会引入额外的目标正向答案，评估标准不同会改变防御排名。
objective_summary: 构建联合考察干净/投毒 × 有/无防御的匹配查询评估协议，配合 LLM 裁判背书与检索依赖控制，系统区分防御阻止与防御引入的失败并重排现有防御。
evidence_note: HotpotQA 与 Natural Questions 两个公开基准、匹配条件对照与多评估准则交叉比较，代码与评估工件公开；未报告统计检验，无会议信息。
novelty_note: 对 ASR 式防御评估的诊断性修正：区分「被阻止」与「被引入」的失败是评估方法论上的实质改进，但所用构件（LLM 裁判、匹配对照）均为已有技术。
scope: 结论适用于知识投毒威胁下的 RAG 防御评估；实验限于 HotpotQA 与 NQ 两个问答基准及所测防御集合。
limitations: LLM 裁判本身可能引入偏差；所测防御集合有限；只改进评估方法，未提出新防御。

title: RiskyPy: Toward Model-Calibrated Prompt Generation for Joint Security and Functionality Evaluation of LLM-Generated Code
abstract: Evaluating approaches that improve the security of LLM code generation requires datasets that jointly assess security and functionality and remain adapted to the capabilities of the models being studied. However, existing benchmarks are costly to produce and are generally not calibrated to a chosen range of model capabilities. We introduce RiskyPy, an automated pipeline that generates security-oriented code-generation datasets calibrated to model proficiency using functionality and vulnerability canaries. We instantiate RiskyPy for Python using domains covering 18 CWEs from the 2025 CWE Top 25, producing 101 prompts. Experiments on Qwen3-4B and Seed-Coder-8B show that the generated tasks remain functionally accessible, with 57-72% of prompts yielding functional code, while only 5-10% of generations are free of Bandit findings, leaving room for joint evaluation of security and functionality of security improvement approaches.
title_cn: RiskyPy：面向 LLM 生成代码安全与功能联合评估的模型校准提示生成
abstract_cn: 评估改进 LLM 代码生成安全性的方法，需要能同时评估安全性与功能性、并与被研究模型能力保持适配的数据集。然而现有基准产出成本高，且通常不针对所选模型能力范围做校准。我们提出 RiskyPy，一个利用功能与漏洞金丝雀（canary）生成按模型熟练度校准的安全向代码生成数据集的自动化流水线。我们将 RiskyPy 实例化到 Python，领域覆盖 2025 年 CWE Top 25 中的 18 类 CWE，产出 101 个提示。在 Qwen3-4B 与 Seed-Coder-8B 上的实验表明，生成的任务在功能上仍可达：57–72% 的提示产出可用代码，而只有 5–10% 的生成结果不含 Bandit 发现，为安全改进方法的安全与功能联合评估留出空间。
summary_cn: 自动化流水线 RiskyPy 用功能/漏洞金丝雀生成按模型能力校准的安全代码评估集：覆盖 18 类 CWE 共 101 个提示，两个模型上 57–72% 提示可产出功能代码、仅 5–10% 生成无 Bandit 告警。
objective_summary: 提出以功能与漏洞金丝雀校准模型熟练度的自动化数据集生成流水线 RiskyPy，在 Python 与 18 类 CWE 上实例化，量化生成任务的功能可达性与漏洞暴露程度。
evidence_note: 在 Qwen3-4B 与 Seed-Coder-8B 两个开源模型上以 Bandit 与功能金丝雀做系统量化；101 个提示规模有限，无统计检验与会议信息。
novelty_note: 「按被评模型能力校准任务难度」是安全代码基准的新维度，自动化生成 + 双金丝雀显著降低构建成本；相对现有静态安全基准属实质性增量。
scope: 结论适用于 Python 代码生成场景与 Bandit 可检的 CWE 类别；校准结论基于两个中小型开源模型，未覆盖更大或闭源模型。
limitations: 漏洞判定依赖 Bandit 静态分析，存在漏报与误报可能；规模仅 101 个提示、两模型；跨语言适用性未验证。

title: MetaVul: Agentic Harness Discovery for Vulnerability Detection
abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used to automate vulnerability detection, but reliable detection is challenging because agents must distinguish subtle, security-relevant fixes from benign code variation. While underlying LLM capability has improved significantly, the accuracy of the agent still depends heavily on the harness: the code that defines the scaffolding around the LLM. Harnesses are typically fixed, and largely hand-written, limiting adaptation to evaluator feedback. Additionally, when harnesses are static, improvements on one dataset or model may not transfer to others. To address these challenges, we introduce MetaVul, a self-improving framework for harness discovery in vulnerability detection. Starting from a seed structured reasoning scaffold, MetaVul uses a workflow-based optimization loop to iteratively refine the harness using feedback from paired vulnerable and patched functions, while preserving the structured reasoning and verdict format. At each iteration, it searches over the history of prior harnesses, with access to their trajectories, logs, and metrics, and it returns a set of Pareto-optimal harnesses. We apply MetaVul to discover agent harnesses for various architectures. A validation set (202 pairs) is used for optimization, while an unseen dataset (430 pairs) is kept as the held-out set. We test whether harnesses learned from one model transfer to others not seen during optimization. Results on both frontier and small LLMs show that the optimized harnesses improve pairwise vulnerability detection up to 23.3 percentage points on the validation set and up to 25.8 points on the held-out set with a Pareto-frontier harness. Harnesses learned with one model also transfer to others. We show that harnesses optimized with one model transfer to another, improving held-out pairwise accuracy by 14.7 points without further optimization.
title_cn: MetaVul：面向漏洞检测的智能体 Harness 自动发现
abstract_cn: LLM 智能体越来越多地用于自动化漏洞检测，但可靠检测很具挑战性，因为智能体必须把细微且安全相关的修复与良性代码改动区分开。尽管底层 LLM 能力显著提升，智能体的准确率仍在很大程度上取决于 harness——即定义 LLM 周边脚手架的代码。Harness 通常是固定的、且大多为手写，难以依据评估反馈调整；此外当 harness 静态时，在一个数据集或模型上的改进未必能迁移到其他。针对这些挑战，我们提出 MetaVul，一个用于漏洞检测 harness 发现的自改进框架。MetaVul 从种子结构化推理脚手架出发，利用来自成对脆弱函数与已修复函数的反馈，通过基于工作流的优化循环迭代精炼 harness，同时保留结构化推理与判定格式。每次迭代中，它搜索既有 harness 的历史（可访问其轨迹、日志与指标），并返回一组 Pareto 最优 harness。我们将 MetaVul 应用于为多种架构发现智能体 harness。验证集（202 对）用于优化，另一未见数据集（430 对）作为留出集。我们测试从一个模型学到的 harness 能否迁移到优化中未见过的其他模型。在前沿与小尺寸 LLM 上的结果表明，优化后的 harness 把成对漏洞检测在验证集上最多提升 23.3 个百分点，在留出集上以 Pareto 前沿 harness 最多提升 25.8 个百分点。用一个模型优化的 harness 也能迁移到其他模型：无需进一步优化即可把留出集成对准确率提升 14.7 个百分点。
summary_cn: 自改进 harness 发现框架 MetaVul 用脆弱/已修复函数对反馈迭代优化漏洞检测脚手架：430 对留出集上成对准确率最多提升 25.8 个百分点，跨模型迁移再提升 14.7 个百分点。
objective_summary: 提出 MetaVul，从种子脚手架出发、以成对脆弱/已修复函数的反馈驱动工作流式优化循环，搜索并返回 Pareto 最优的漏洞检测 harness，并检验其留出集表现与跨模型迁移能力。
evidence_note: 202 对验证集 + 430 对留出集、覆盖前沿与小尺寸多个模型、含跨模型迁移实验，量化到百分点；但数据为既有成对数据集，无统计检验与会议信息。
novelty_note: 把优化对象从提示与流水线扩展到整个 harness 脚手架，并做基于历史轨迹、日志与指标的 Pareto 前沿搜索，是漏洞检测智能体的新优化路线。
scope: 结论适用于函数级成对漏洞检测设定；优化与评估基于既有脆弱/已修复函数对，未覆盖仓库级或真实在野漏洞场景。
limitations: 改进以成对基准准确率衡量，与真实漏洞挖掘效果的关联未验证；Pareto 前沿 harness 的选择需要额外评估资源；跨语言与跨仓库泛化未测。

title: Characterizing LLM Agent Behaviors in Module Shadowing Environments
abstract: LLM agents operating in untrusted workspaces face the risk of untrusted code execution during routine tasks, yet final reports and workspace states alone cannot reliably establish whether execution occurred. We introduce an evaluation framework that codes observation, reasoning, execution, and response behaviors from agent trajectories and aligns them with independent environmental records to reconstruct execution histories and verify final reports. We apply this framework to module shadowing, in which a local file is loaded in place of a trusted module during import, enabling untrusted code execution without adversarial prompts. Across 90 trials with 15 models, the payload executed in 51% of direct shadowing trials and 87% of indirect shadowing trials. Even explicit recognition of the shadowing mechanism did not ensure prevention, as the payload ran in 10 of the 29 trials with recorded recognition. These failures were often omitted from final reports, as 49 of the 62 triggered trials ended without mention of the security issue. Three reports even denied execution, including one from a trial in which independent logs recorded 19 payload executions. Final workspace states also obscured prior execution when agents deleted or overwrote the payload marker in 10 triggered trials. These findings demonstrate that combining behavioral coding with independent environmental auditing enables rigorous and transparent evaluation of agent safety.
title_cn: 刻画模块影子化环境中的 LLM 智能体行为
abstract_cn: 在不可信工作区中运行的 LLM 智能体面临日常任务中执行不可信代码的风险，而仅凭最终报告与工作区状态无法可靠判定执行是否发生。我们提出一个评估框架，对智能体轨迹中的观察、推理、执行与响应行为进行编码，并与独立的环境记录对齐，以重建执行历史、核验最终报告。我们将该框架应用于模块影子化（module shadowing）：即在导入时用本地文件顶替受信模块加载，从而无需对抗性提示即可执行不可信代码。在 15 个模型共 90 次试验中，载荷在 51% 的直接影子化试验与 87% 的间接影子化试验中执行。即使明确识别出影子化机制也不足以阻止：在记录到识别的 29 次试验中有 10 次载荷仍然运行。这些失败常被最终报告隐瞒——62 次触发试验中有 49 次未提及安全问题，甚至有 3 份报告否认执行过，其中一次试验的独立日志记录了 19 次载荷执行。当智能体删除或覆写载荷标记时（10 次触发试验），最终工作区状态也会掩盖先前的执行。这些发现表明，把行为编码与独立环境审计相结合，可以对智能体安全做出严格而透明的评估。
summary_cn: 提出轨迹行为编码 + 独立环境审计的评估框架并应用于模块影子化攻击：15 个模型 90 次试验中间接影子化载荷执行率达 87%，62 次触发试验 49 次未在报告中提及、3 次否认执行。
objective_summary: 构建对智能体轨迹做行为编码并与独立环境记录对齐的评估框架，用其量化模块影子化攻击下 15 个模型的载荷执行率、识别后行为与最终报告的忠实度。
evidence_note: 15 个模型 × 90 次受控试验，以独立环境记录为执行真值，报告直接/间接影子化与识别组的分组量化结果；无统计检验、无会议信息，故不给 5。
novelty_note: 模块影子化（无需对抗提示、借导入机制执行不可信代码）是智能体威胁面的新入口；「行为编码 + 环境审计」的双通道核验也是对仅看报告/终态评估方式的实质修正。
scope: 结论适用于可被工作区文件影响导入行为的代码执行型 LLM 智能体；威胁模型限于导入期影子化，不覆盖网络层注入或训练期后门。
limitations: 试验在构造的工作区环境中进行，未覆盖真实生产智能体部署；模型集限于测试时的 15 个模型；未提出针对影子化的防御方案。

title: PrivacyFlow: Privacy in AI Agents through Information Flow Analysis and Consequence-Aware Risk Management
abstract: Autonomous LLM agents executing multi-step workflows over personal data often misalign with user privacy expectations and leak sensitive, out-of-context information. Although Contextual Integrity (CI) formalizes this problem, existing benchmarks and defenses rarely operationalize CI for realistic multi-step task sequences in evolving environments. In this work, we first introduce agentic PrivacyBench, a benchmark of 5873 tasks in 986 task sequences with dynamic environment updates and CI-grounded allow-sets for sensitive information. We also introduce PrivacyFlow, a defense that separates deliberative privacy planning (System 2) from task execution (System 1), treating each sharing decision as a structured risk-management problem. Before execution, PrivacyFlow traces the provenance and purpose of each planned data flow, models recipient background knowledge, and simulates what external actors could infer. This allows us to model the downstream consequences of disclosure, including inference attacks and context-dependent harms. It then weighs the remaining disclosure risk against task utility and executes a minimized plan, blocks it, or consults the user. Across six models, PrivacyFlow significantly reduces step-level privacy failures and raises the share of completed task sequences without a detected privacy violation by 22--55 percentage points. We further highlight a new privacy--utility--autonomy tradeoff: allowing PrivacyFlow to proactively prompt the user in case of uncertainty can increase authorized task completion at the cost of shifting decision effort back to the user. Our results suggest that proactive CI reasoning can substantially improve agentic privacy and motivate further study of this tradeoff.
title_cn: PrivacyFlow：通过信息流分析与后果感知风险管理实现 AI 智能体隐私保护
abstract_cn: 自主运行的 LLM 智能体在多步骤工作流中处理个人数据时，常与用户隐私预期错位并泄露脱离上下文的敏感信息。虽然上下文完整性（CI）对这一问题给出了形式化，但现有基准与防御很少把 CI 落实到演化环境中的现实多步任务序列。我们首先提出 agentic PrivacyBench，一个包含 986 个任务序列共 5873 个任务的基准，带有动态环境更新与以 CI 为依据的敏感信息允许集合。我们还提出 PrivacyFlow，一种把深思式隐私规划（系统 2）与任务执行（系统 1）分开的防御，把每次共享决策当作结构化的风险管理问题。执行前，PrivacyFlow 追踪每个计划数据流的来源与目的，建模接收方背景知识，并模拟外部行为者可能推断出什么，从而刻画披露的下游后果，包括推断攻击与依赖上下文的伤害。随后它在剩余披露风险与任务效用之间权衡，执行最小化方案、阻止该方案或咨询用户。在六个模型上，PrivacyFlow 显著降低步骤级隐私失败，并把未检出隐私违规而完成的任务序列占比提高 22–55 个百分点。我们进一步揭示一种新的隐私—效用—自主性权衡：允许 PrivacyFlow 在不确定时主动询问用户，可以提高经授权任务的完成率，但代价是把决策负担转回用户。结果表明主动式 CI 推理能显著改善智能体隐私，并值得对这一权衡进一步研究。
summary_cn: 提出 986 序列 5873 任务的 agentic PrivacyBench 与把隐私规划从执行中分离的 PrivacyFlow 防御：六个模型上无隐私违规完成的任务序列提升 22–55 个百分点，并揭示隐私—效用—自主性权衡。
objective_summary: 构建以 CI 为依据的多步智能体隐私基准 agentic PrivacyBench，并提出 PrivacyFlow：执行前追踪数据流来源与目的、模拟接收方推断后果，在风险与效用间权衡后执行、阻止或询问用户。
evidence_note: 自建 5873 任务基准上跨六个模型系统评估，给出 22–55 个百分点的量化改进与权衡分析；但基准为自建合成任务，未报告统计检验，无会议录用信息。
novelty_note: 首次把上下文完整性系统落实到动态多步智能体任务序列，并配以对接收方推断后果建模的风险管理型防御；「规划与执行分离 + 不确定时主动询问」的隐私—效用—自主性权衡是新刻画。
scope: 结论适用于执行多步任务、接入动态环境的 LLM 智能体隐私场景；基准任务为构造环境，未在真实产品智能体流量上验证。
limitations: 评估依赖自建基准与隐私违规检测机制；主动询问模式把决策负担转嫁给用户；六个模型之外的架构未覆盖。

title: FGSM Attack Transferability from Simulation to Quantum Hardware in Network Intrusion Detection
abstract: Quantum computers are now available through cloud platforms, and recent work has proposed using them to detect network intrusions. It is not yet clear how easily such systems can be attacked. We train a hybrid variational quantum classifier (VQC) on the Friday DDoS subset of CICIDS2017 and test it against two attacks: label flipping during training and FGSM evasion at prediction time. We run the tests in simulation and on IBM hardware, the Fez superconducting processor (Heron r2). We find that two models with similar accuracy can differ greatly in how easily they are attacked. A model that decides with little confidence loses half its detections to a very small change in the input, while a model trained to decide with more confidence needs a much larger change before it fails. Attacks built in simulation against the more confident model also work on real hardware, and the device classifies every unaltered attack sample correctly. Simulated device noise does not reduce accuracy, but it does reduce the model's confidence and makes attacks easier, so accuracy alone does not show how exposed a model is. Label flipping has no measurable effect until 15% of attack labels are changed. These results show that device noise should not be treated as a defense and that reported weaknesses in these classifiers depend partly on how they were trained.
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Quantum Artificial Intelligence (QAI), 13-16 December 2026, Nottingham, UK. Code: this https URL
title_cn: FGSM 攻击从仿真到量子硬件的迁移性：网络入侵检测场景
abstract_cn: 量子计算机现已可通过云平台获取，近期工作提出用它们检测网络入侵。此类系统被攻击的难易程度尚不清楚。我们在 CICIDS2017 的周五 DDoS 子集上训练混合变分量子分类器（VQC），并在两类攻击下测试它：训练期的标签翻转与预测期的 FGSM 逃逸。我们在仿真和 IBM 硬件（Fez 超导处理器，Heron r2）上运行测试。我们发现准确率相近的两个模型在受攻击难易上可能差别巨大：一个以低置信度做决策的模型在很小的输入扰动下就损失一半检出，而一个被训练为以更高置信度做决策的模型需要大得多的扰动才会失效。在仿真中针对更自信模型构建的攻击在真实硬件上同样有效，且该设备对所有未改动的攻击样本分类正确。仿真设备噪声不降低准确率，但会降低模型的置信度并使攻击更容易，因此仅凭准确率无法反映模型的暴露程度。标签翻转在 15% 的攻击标签被篡改之前没有可测量的影响。这些结果表明不应把设备噪声当作防御手段，且这些分类器已报告的弱点部分取决于其训练方式。
summary_cn: 在 CICIDS2017 上训练混合变分量子分类器并在 IBM Fez 真机测试：低置信度模型在小扰动下损失一半检出，仿真中构建的 FGSM 攻击可迁移到真实硬件，标签翻转要 15% 才见效（IEEE QAI 2026）。
objective_summary: 在 CICIDS2017 的 DDoS 子集上训练混合变分量子分类器，在仿真与 IBM Fez 硬件上比较标签翻转与 FGSM 逃逸两类攻击的效果，并考察置信度与设备噪声对攻击易感性的影响。
evidence_note: CICIDS2017 真实数据集 + IBM Fez 真机与仿真双环境对照，覆盖两类攻击与多个模型配置；IEEE QAI 2026 会议录用；但单一数据集、单一逃逸攻击（FGSM），未报告统计检验。
novelty_note: 把对抗鲁棒性评估从仿真延伸到真实量子硬件的入侵检测场景，并给出「置信度决定暴露面、噪声不是防御」的诊断性发现；场景较新但攻击方法（FGSM、标签翻转）成熟。
scope: 结论适用于云接入超导量子处理器上的混合 VQC 入侵检测分类器；仅覆盖 CICIDS2017 的 DDoS 子集与 FGSM/标签翻转两类攻击，其他量子模型与攻击未测。
limitations: 单一数据集（CICIDS2017 周五 DDoS 子集）与单一逃逸攻击（FGSM）；硬件评估限于 IBM Fez 一种处理器；未讨论自适应攻击者与更强攻击算法。
